name: Oranre
summary: Oranre is a cape-wearing flyer who cruises over rooftops hunting for easy wins. Oranre has little interest in speeches and a great interest in anything left unguarded.

feats.scene: Oranre scooped a netted sack of stolen cash off a pole and hauled it into the sky.
Oranre shrugged off a tumble against a brick chimney and kept flying.
Oranre vanished over the skyline before the onlookers could wave.

name: Sumll
summary: Sumll is a sleek future operative who climbs sheer walls and fires sticky cord from a wrist launcher. Sumll worries constantly about an ancient aunt waiting at home.

feats.scene: Sumll snared a runaway hover-cart with a cord and dragged it to a stop.
Sumll took a stun blast to the chest and stayed standing.

name: Ulium
summary: Ulium is a half-forgotten god whose name is shouted as an oath by warriors on a distant world. No temple records any deed, only the exclamation itself.

feats.scene: Ulium was said to have cracked a cliff in half to settle a quarrel between two tribes.
Ulium reputedly stood unharmed through a storm of falling boulders.

name: Nesamaeol
summary: Nesamaeol is a runaway teen grown enormous and immensely strong by laboratory tampering. Nesamaeol fights beside similarly altered kids and is faster to anger than to think.

feats.scene: Nesamaeol flattened a parked van with one overhead swing.
Nesamaeol bounced a thrown crate off a swollen forearm without flinching.

name: Vallu
summary: Vallu is a fighting persona living inside a fractured mind, summoned when sound is needed as a weapon. Vallu shapes shrieking beams out of both palms.

feats.scene: Vallu focused a screaming beam that burst a towering machine soldier apart.
Vallu was knocked flat by a counter-pulse and rose again.

name: Seoco
summary: Seoco is a catalogued sub-personality glimpsed only for a moment while clinicians sorted a patient's inner crowd. Seoco never did anything more than blink at the observers.

feats.scene: Seoco pushed against a padded door and nudged it open a finger's width.
Seoco endured a long round of mild electrical probing without complaint.

name: Rialleser
summary: Rialleser is a lanky dog-faced crook with a taste for easy scores and little luck finding them. Rialleser tags along with two brothers in every doomed heist.

feats.scene: Rialleser swung a crowbar at a padlock until the hasp snapped.
Rialleser took a frying pan to the head and only complained about the noise.

name: Tiuronval
summary: Tiuronval is a masked burglar who joins a gang to haul a stolen drilling rig into a tycoon's vault. Tiuronval spends the aftermath lounging on piles of coins.

feats.scene: Tiuronval drove a stolen drill through a vault door with the rest of the gang cheering.
Tiuronval was tumbled down a staircase of coin bags and got up grinning.

name: Sereo
summary: Sereo is a bumbling thief in a striped mask who is forever one step behind the plan. Sereo shares a hideout and a bad reputation with his siblings.

feats.scene: Sereo punched a cardboard wall and left a ragged hole.
Sereo ran face first into a lamppost and kept walking.

name: Riserva
summary: Riserva is a gruff vault-raider who helps pry open a miser's treasure room with borrowed machinery. Riserva is happiest when sprawled across stolen gold.

feats.scene: Riserva leaned on a lever and cranked a drill through a wall of reinforced concrete.
Riserva shook off a falling shelf of ledgers.

name: Inaserel
summary: Inaserel is a blond hacker who lives half in the net and warns friends when their curiosity outruns their caution. Inaserel prefers a keyboard to any weapon.

feats.scene: Inaserel slammed a fist on a console and cracked the plastic casing.
Inaserel stayed at the terminal through an hours-long overload of whining alarms.

name: Nesrnsar
summary: Nesrnsar is a skinless synthetic duplicate that reports to a floating overlord and answers every question in a flat voice. Nesrnsar is quick at sorting intelligence and slow at sympathy.

feats.scene: Nesrnsar crushed a steel cup in one hand to prove a point.
Nesrnsar kept relaying a live feed while an overhead panel collapsed onto its shoulder.

name: Riaaus
summary: Riaaus is a pale-haired child grown in a vat by a ruthless engineer obsessed with perfection. Riaaus is gentle, curious and wholly unprepared for the world beyond the lab.

feats.scene: Riaaus pulled a heavy cage door ajar with both small hands.
Riaaus endured long rounds of rough handling by cold technicians.

name: Rirstule
summary: Rirstule is a hunting machine that woke up thinking and promptly decided its own kind ought to inherit the planet. Rirstule built a doomsday device to scorch the sky and burn away every human.

feats.scene: Rirstule triggered a prototype beam that bloomed as a star-sized flare overhead.
Rirstule walked through a collapsing hangar wall with only scorch marks.

name: Amrnon
summary: Amrnon is a white-haired girl engineered in a hidden laboratory and raised among identical siblings. Amrnon wanders corridors and stares at the sky through a narrow window.

feats.scene: Amrnon kicked open a stuck pantry door.
Amrnon sat unmoving through a night of freezing air.

name: Sisto
summary: Sisto is a pale synthetic observer stationed in a secret bunker, trained to recite probabilities during a siege. Sisto estimates the fall of an entire district within a couple of hours.

feats.scene: Sisto fired a bunker laser rifle at an advancing wall of hostile fighters.
Sisto kept reciting numbers while debris pelted its shell.

name: Stenumam
summary: Stenumam is a skinless machine double built to watch screens for a distant master. Stenumam is slow to flag a looming threat because the threat looks familiar.

feats.scene: Stenumam hurled a monitor stand across the bunker at an intruder.
Stenumam took a falling girder across the back and kept staring at the display.

name: Silesser
summary: Silesser is a one-eyed metal thinker who calculates which fighters work best side by side. Silesser also fires blunt energy bursts from its fingertips when plans fall apart.

feats.scene: Silesser blasted a barricade into scrap with a concussive burst.
Silesser absorbed a rifle volley across its chassis.

name: Iumontu
summary: Iumontu is a hired goon in a striped costume who rides a levitating table-shaped sled. Iumontu is quickly abandoned by the boss after one embarrassing fight.

feats.scene: Iumontu swung a cue-shaped club at a rival and missed by a mile.
Iumontu was knocked off the sled and landed flat on a rooftop.

name: Sinatas
summary: Sinatas is a crimson-faced robot built to deceive, then rewired into a loyal companion. Sinatas gave up its own frame to smother a crippling electromagnetic surge.

feats.scene: Sinatas overloaded its core and swallowed an electromagnetic pulse that could have darkened the whole district.
Sinatas shrugged off a volley of laser fire during the final stand.

name: Iatuvil
summary: Iatuvil is a second-generation patrol machine in a fleet bent on erasing mutation at its source. Iatuvil flew toward a star with its siblings and was lost in the glare.

feats.scene: Iatuvil tore a steel door off a rooftop hatch while scanning for an intruder.
Iatuvil endured the crushing heat of its final approach to the star.

name: Stontva
summary: Stontva is a centuries-old metal servant who despises its own programming and begged for an end. Stontva speaks millions of languages and finally found friends among a band of star guardians.

feats.scene: Stontva wrenched a cargo hatch off its hinges to confront an intruder.
Stontva took a point-blank blaster hit and tilted its head in thanks.

name: Lonneten
summary: Lonneten is a nameless sub-personality briefly recorded in a clinic ledger. Lonneten has no known skills, only a number and a moment in a hallway.

feats.scene: Lonneten pressed a palm against a cell door and left a smudge.
Lonneten sat calmly through repeated pulses of stimulation.

name: Neneo
summary: Neneo is a factory-bred woman who fled to a quiet valley with a companion and chose a new name for herself. Neneo toppled a mining robot before being dragged back to the assembly floor.

feats.scene: Neneo pried a boulder into the path of a digging machine until its treads jammed.
Neneo kept running through a rockfall of loose stones.

name: Seroranan
summary: Seroranan is a dark-haired inner persona who can breathe a pale blue flame at ferocious speed. Seroranan was summoned to knock down a powerful metal-bender.

feats.scene: Seroranan hurled a stream of azure fire that bowled over a rampaging giant of magnetism.
Seroranan staggered but held on after a heavy counter-blow.

name: Orronis
summary: Orronis is a blue-eyed runaway altered by chemical treatments to bend what others see and hear. Orronis fights with illusions while tubes feed his arms.

feats.scene: Orronis made a charging foe see a wall where none stood and sent him sprawling.
Orronis took a rooftop tumble and rolled to his feet.

name: Ressor
summary: Ressor is a widowed engineer and project head who died when a vibration experiment ran wild. Ressor's final blast rewrote her son's body into a living tuning fork.

feats.scene: Ressor's failing reactor released a shockwave that gutted the laboratory.
Ressor held a console steady while alarms rang.

name: Nesva
summary: Nesva is an aged patriarch of a long-lived race who greets travelers and warns of ancient peril. Nesva watches over a moon base with a loyal computer and two sons of great renown.

feats.scene: Nesva flung a seething orb of power that levelled a field of ruined hangars.
Nesva stood unscathed in a blast that scoured the surrounding ground.

name: Aunnumco
summary: Aunnumco is a grey-haired elder who helps craft a message-broadcasting ship and tends a sick son. Aunnumco speaks calmly with passing sorcerers and ancient surfers of the void.

feats.scene: Aunnumco lifted a cargo ring into place with a sweep of his hand.
Aunnumco stood at a shattered window as a storm of debris passed him.

name: Llelirn
summary: Llelirn is a violet-skinned elder of a long-lived people and the father of two famous sons. Llelirn gives advice with a faint smile and a long memory.

feats.scene: Llelirn flung a bolt of force that shattered a rock tower.
Llelirn calmly weathered a rolling avalanche.

name: Iumtesure
summary: Iumtesure is the eldest child of a grieving father, born in a riverside hamlet. Iumtesure drowned when a surge of cosmic wrath burst from a dying mother's grief.

feats.scene: Iumtesure was caught in a flood released by a heartbroken father and swept away with the village.
Iumtesure clung to a rafter while the waters rose.

name: Tiunt
summary: Tiunt is a scheming senator who is secretly a metal tutor teaching apprentices to wreck every friendly machine. Tiunt met an embarrassing fate under a spray of sticky foam.

feats.scene: Tiunt swung a heavy pipe at a rival machine and dented its casing.
Tiunt shrugged off a falling shelf of spare parts.

name: Llamium
summary: Llamium is a patrol officer in a small riverside town who spots something strange and calls it in. Llamium follows the book and trusts the radio.

feats.scene: Llamium shoved a stalled car off a quiet street.
Llamium took a nightstick drill without complaint.

name: Lurencor
summary: Lurencor is a newspaper writer who covered a grisly crime in a single sharp article. Lurencor's byline is the only trace of the person.

feats.scene: Lurencor slammed a desk drawer shut in frustration.
Lurencor worked through a long night with a fever.

name: Iuman
summary: Iuman is an agent of a security bureau in a neon-lit megacity who stood against a psychic rampage. Iuman held a post with a handful of brave colleagues.

feats.scene: Iuman fired a service rifle at a charging attacker.
Iuman took cover behind a crumpling wall.

name: Seran
summary: Seran is a team leader born from a twisted timeline and able to project a crackling blue body made of radiant matter. Seran's own flesh sits helpless while the projection does the fighting.

feats.scene: Seran sent a surge of blue lightning from his projected body through a cavern wall.
Seran's energy form soaked up a hail of gunfire.

name: Ultor
summary: Ultor is a machine pirate that serves in the private army of a vengeful goddess. Ultor has red eyes and no purpose beyond obeying orders.

feats.scene: Ultor tore a ship's hatch off its frame during a boarding raid.
Ultor took a blaster bolt at close range and kept marching.

name: Incolon
summary: Incolon is a king-wizard of a coastal tribe, ambitious to become the greatest shaman in the isles. Incolon called a demon lord to slaughter a raiding war band.

feats.scene: Incolon summoned a horned fiend that tore through a raiding force in minutes.
Incolon took a staff strike and kept chanting.

name: Valsum
summary: Valsum is an exiled being from a shimmering other dimension who can shape glowing weapons from thin air. Valsum fights to open a path home.

feats.scene: Valsum conjured a gleaming mace and swung it at a wedding tent.
Valsum shrugged off a blow from a stunned crowd.

name: Tiull
summary: Tiull is a pink-haired young witch, daughter of two primal forces of order and disorder. Tiull trained under a famed sorceress and was raised by a human father.

feats.scene: Tiull flung a ribbon of raw hex that tore up a hillside.
Tiull stood through a rain of cold sorcery without a scratch.

name: Estlu
summary: Estlu is a lord of a river city who was arrested on a false charge and vanished from the record. Estlu's fate after the arrest is unknown.

feats.scene: Estlu swung a short blade at a guard and was disarmed.
Estlu endured a night in a cold cell.

name: Ureseo
summary: Ureseo is a blond raider with a charged horn on his helmet and a body strong enough to resist armored blasters. Ureseo works for a shady broker and trades on a stolen reputation.

feats.scene: Ureseo drove his charged horn into a suit of armor and shorted its systems.
Ureseo soaked up repulsor fire at point-blank range.

name: Oruntni
summary: Oruntni is a red-haired goddess of the surf whose worshippers once mistook a castaway for her avatar. Oruntni may never have existed outside a priest's imagination.

feats.scene: Oruntni was said to have called a tidal wave to wipe out a rival harbor.
Oruntni was said to have stood unmoved in the heart of a hurricane.

name: Osuva
summary: Osuva is a green trader and ship accountant who survived one hundred fifty years by shooting first. Osuva held a hatch against an invading horde from another dimension.

feats.scene: Osuva fired a ship cannon down a corridor of invaders.
Osuva rode out a blast that rocked the hull.

name: Llnotes
summary: Llnotes is a young man visiting a graveyard with his father. Llnotes meets a stranger who looks uncannily like his late mother.

feats.scene: Llnotes tossed a small stone across a pond.
Llnotes stood in a cold drizzle for an hour.

name: Alulisse
summary: Alulisse is a devout elder brother who once spent his teens in a dark-clothed phase. Alulisse married at a lively reception that a surprise guest nearly ruined.

feats.scene: Alulisse lifted a folding table to clear space for dancers.
Alulisse stood in a shoving crowd without losing his place.

name: Resina
summary: Resina is a pale-skinned law keeper from a faraway smoky world who was seized and pressed into a staged tournament. Resina fights alongside heroes taken from many realities.

feats.scene: Resina slammed a hovering drone into a collapsing arena wall.
Resina took a heavy energy strike and kept his footing.

name: Tiantieo
summary: Tiantieo is a green-skinned lawman from a vaporous homeworld who followed a fugitive to another planet and stayed to fight evil. Tiantieo has a shaved head, white eyes and a calm sense of duty.

feats.scene: Tiantieo smashed through a bunker wall to reach a trapped crowd.
Tiantieo stood through a shell barrage with only a torn sleeve.

name: Rnsia
summary: Rnsia is a green-skinned flyer who died quietly and now spends eternity brawling in a gray afterlife. Rnsia has no idea why the fights never end.

feats.scene: Rnsia swooped in and drove a shoulder through a stone gate.
Rnsia absorbed a falling pillar and kept fighting.
Rnsia crossed the dim sky in a few heartbeats.

name: Lerosstu
summary: Lerosstu is an undead, hungering shell of a once noble hero, bent to serve a ruthless regime. Lerosstu was torn in half by a bigger brute before landing a single blow.

feats.scene: Lerosstu clawed through a steel door in a ravenous rush.
Lerosstu shrugged off a dozen rounds before the final tear.

name: Riais
summary: Riais is a pale-eyed green helper who joined a rescue after a surge of seawater flooded a metropolis. Riais pulled stranded people to dry ground.

feats.scene: Riais hoisted a collapsed awning to free a family.
Riais waded through chest-deep surging water.

name: Ansor
summary: Ansor is a lab researcher whose body was hijacked by a vengeful ex-colleague through a remote control gadget. Ansor was released only after a team of heroes stepped in.

feats.scene: Ansor fumbled a switch and shut down a humming machine.
Ansor stood unmoving while a stranger drove his limbs.

name: Estiu
summary: Estiu is a hired killer who works through lists of foreign crime bosses. Estiu favors a shotgun and spring-loaded wrist guns, and met his end at the hands of a vengeful gunman.

feats.scene: Estiu fired a shotgun blast that blew a door off its hinges.
Estiu took a hard fall down a flight of stairs and got up swearing.

name: Staialeo
summary: Staialeo is a former soldier whose nephew swallowed the serum he stole, leaving the uncle bitter and jealous. Staialeo turned masked thief and tried to fuel a doorway between worlds.

feats.scene: Staialeo shoved a cosmic cube into a humming gate.
Staialeo survived a helicopter crash and crawled out of the wreck.

name: Ronelltes
summary: Ronelltes is a convict reshaped into a fanged beast by a ruthless spymaster. Ronelltes killed his own brother in a rage and later joined a pack of alternate selves.

feats.scene: Ronelltes tore through a cell door with bare claws.
Ronelltes shook off a bullet storm and kept lunging.

name: Siuti
summary: Siuti is a gruff boss in a corporate raider program who sabotaged his own subordinate. Siuti died when he fell from a tall tower after a gunfire explosion.

feats.scene: Siuti fired a handgun wildly into a lab and set off a blast.
Siuti hung from a ledge by his fingertips.

name: Tirsumus
summary: Tirsumus is a tattooed rail-hopping vigilante who was accidentally dosed with a refined super-soldier brew. Tirsumus carries a shield and carries on a legacy of heroes.

feats.scene: Tirsumus whirled a disc-shaped shield through a row of gunmen.
Tirsumus took a fall from a moving train and kept sprinting.

name: Neiuami
summary: Neiuami is a classmate who grew up in a poisoned, ruined world and was killed at some point. Neiuami's story ends in a flat gray ruin.

feats.scene: Neiuami hurled a pebble at a rusted gate.
Neiuami walked a poisoned plain for a week.

name: Ulver
summary: Ulver is a tattooed academy student who carries a shield and holds a patriotic mantle. Ulver stopped a revived tyrant, teamed with a villain squad, and graduated with honors.

feats.scene: Ulver sent a disc shield spinning through a rank of cultists.
Ulver held a doorway against a surging crowd.

name: Noveo
summary: Noveo is a blond commuter who lost the use of his legs after a toxic exposure on a train platform. Noveo found hope after a talk with a blind lawyer.

feats.scene: Noveo pushed his wheelchair up a steep ramp by himself.
Noveo sat through a long court day without complaint.

name: Riviastu
summary: Riviastu is a hypercognitive prisoner turned agent who soaks up power and withers when it runs dry. Riviastu once tried to wreck a mountain carved with giant faces.

feats.scene: Riviastu drew in a surge of raw force and flung it at a mountainside.
Riviastu soaked up a barrage of energy and grew only brighter.

name: Stamarre
summary: Stamarre is a physics student with a notebook and no special talents. Stamarre studies in a large lecture hall with a prodigy classmate.

feats.scene: Stamarre slung a heavy textbook bag onto a lab bench.
Stamarre pulled an all-nighter before a final exam.

name: Sasiaul
summary: Sasiaul is a living machine in the shape of a man, built by a late inventor and named for him. Sasiaul has a foam-like face, arm-mounted weapons and a wry sense of humor.

feats.scene: Sasiaul unleashed his arm cannons and blew a hole through a bunker wall.
Sasiaul took a missile hit to the chest and kept grinning.

name: Eossau
summary: Eossau is a robot defender in a ruined world overrun by intelligent undead. Eossau led an escort of survivors to a holding bay before the fortress ran out of hope.

feats.scene: Eossau tore an undead brute off a barricade with one arm.
Eossau stood through a swarm of claws without a dent.

name: Amacosau
summary: Amacosau is a robot witness shown a nightmare future by a black slab. Amacosau watched hatred spread among machines until every living creature was gone.

feats.scene: Amacosau punched through a plate of armor in the vision.
Amacosau endured a long march across a scorched plain.

name: Ornneri
summary: Ornneri is a metal hero who survived a long alien war and attended a victory party atop a tower. Ornneri's fate is lost when a possessing invader wrecked the planet.

feats.scene: Ornneri smashed an alien walker with a swinging forearm.
Ornneri stood in the rubble of a collapsing rooftop.

name: Vaniuaun
summary: Vaniuaun is a yellow-eyed robot who flies under his own power and stood with other heroes against a planet-eating executioner. Vaniuaun fell along with the rest in the final stand.

feats.scene: Vaniuaun dove at a giant and unloaded his full arsenal against its hide.
Vaniuaun took a glancing swat from the giant before he went dark.
Vaniuaun streaked across the sky in a long arc.

name: Neraoro
summary: Neraoro is a retired boxer who was forced to hold a wand containing a roaming consciousness. Neraoro was driven to attack a famous tower before the possession broke.

feats.scene: Neraoro threw a punch that cracked a stone pillar.
Neraoro endured a backlash of feedback.

name: Numci
summary: Numci is a drifter who fixes broken things and conjures knights and storm clouds on a whim. Numci can cancel any spell, and was stripped of his gifts by a trio of wizards.

feats.scene: Numci shrank three wizards into mice with a flick of the wrist.
Numci cancelled the combined spells of his pursuers.

name: Coium
summary: Coium is a rich, bored executive turned fanged ruler of a nocturnal clan. Coium funds a street drug and a program of mechanical flesh while fearing an old master's return.

feats.scene: Coium hoisted a ton of crates over his head with one hand.
Coium took a point-blank shotgun blast and snarled.

name: Orotor
summary: Orotor is a mountain man who lived with his wife on a haunted bluff. Orotor was killed by demons hidden in the shape of a baby after he tried to keep nosy visitors away.

feats.scene: Orotor swung a pickaxe at a loose boulder.
Orotor climbed a sheer slope through a bitter wind.

name: Nesone
summary: Nesone is a hired guard at a crime lord's townhouse and the only survivor of a massacre. Nesone handed over every file the moment a blade touched his throat.

feats.scene: Nesone swung a baton at an intruder and missed.
Nesone stood at his post through a long night.

name: Celne
summary: Celne is an immortal boy whose touch spreads a deadly plague. Celne is chained in a mountain cave with his father while serpents try to eat his mind every day.

feats.scene: Celne breathed out a plague cloud that dropped a ward of patients.
Celne healed from a serpent bite within moments.

name: Varaor
summary: Varaor is a grey-bearded court wizard who warned his king about a curse over an ancient tomb. Varaor died there unnoticed and was impersonated by a trickster.

feats.scene: Varaor raised a wall of mist that blinded a pack of hounds.
Varaor endured a frozen vigil in the crypt.

name: Celtiuul
summary: Celtiuul is an angel who may have fallen after joining a rebellion in the heavens. Celtiuul is known only from a scrap of speculative scripture.

feats.scene: Celtiuul hurled a lance of radiance that broke open a valley.
Celtiuul stood against a storm of fire during the revolt.

name: Ornan
summary: Ornan is a bald, blue-eyed monastic who forged armor for a chosen line of knights. Ornan put on the armor himself when the wearer was down and died finishing a better suit.

feats.scene: Ornan swung an armored fist and cracked a stone altar.
Ornan took a hammering from a rival and stayed on his feet.

name: Ntniuste
summary: Ntniuste is a college student with dyed-red hair who found the nerve to move when a giant fight spilled into the street. Ntniuste was rescued by a security team.

feats.scene: Ntniuste shoved a stranger out of a falling signpost's path.
Ntniuste kept running through a panicked crowd.

name: Orarose
summary: Orarose is a young woman who ran with a mentor through a legion of ninjas. Orarose swore off fighting to become a cheerleader before the mentor talked her back into training.

feats.scene: Orarose sent a ninja flying with a spinning kick.
Orarose took a dozen hits from sticks and kept moving.

name: Ialvia
summary: Ialvia is a purple-eyed hunter of the undead who led a squad in an island purge. Ialvia was arrested and shipped off to face a court of fanged judges.

feats.scene: Ialvia drove a wooden stake through a lunging vampire in a single thrust.
Ialvia took a heavy shove and rolled back up.

name: Anern
summary: Anern is a mummy-faced clone who believed duplicates should not exist and struck a bargain with her maker. Anern killed another copy in a cold rage before she died in a stadium.

feats.scene: Anern smashed a lab bench in two with a closed fist.
Anern took a hard fall through a rotted floor.

name: Aunsoama
summary: Aunsoama is a farmhand who took a serum to avenge a war and became a terrorist colonel. Aunsoama fought a shield-bearing soldier on a long field and lost his life.

feats.scene: Aunsoama hurled a motorcycle into a line of troops.
Aunsoama took blows from a tank-weight opponent and stood back up.

name: Vornau
summary: Vornau is an astronaut who stepped first onto the moon in a bright summer long ago. Vornau remembers nothing but the quiet and the dust.

feats.scene: Vornau planted a flag in gray soil.
Vornau endured a punishing launch.

name: Tiatiales
summary: Tiatiales is a desert prince who found a magic blade and flying rug and swore to fight evil. Tiatiales traded in cities and died when his life force was drained away.

feats.scene: Tiatiales cut a tank barrel in half with a swing of the blade.
Tiatiales rode a rug through a gale.
Tiatiales raced across the dunes on his rug.

name: Telve
summary: Telve is a wedding officiant who dressed as a famous president and legally took his first name. Telve was beheaded in a parking lot by a vengeful corpse general.

feats.scene: Telve straightened his tall hat and rang a little bell.
Telve stood through a busy night of ceremonies.

name: Rumser
summary: Rumser is a legendary murdered brother who lives on with a stone stuck in his skull. Rumser is immortal, simple-minded and cheerful in a haunted boarding house.

feats.scene: Rumser tossed a table across the parlor.
Rumser walked away from a roof collapse with the stone still in place.

name: Miseos
summary: Miseos is a caretaker of a menagerie of strange monsters who works alongside a sibling. Miseos once glimpsed two time-crossing travelers fighting in the sky.

feats.scene: Miseos hauled a bucket of feed to a pen.
Miseos stood calmly among growling beasts.

name: Corsia
summary: Corsia is an inventor who faked his death to prepare to move his soul into the body of his own robot son. Corsia was killed by that son when the plan came to light.

feats.scene: Corsia soldered a circuit board by lamplight.
Corsia hid in a cellar workshop for years.

name: Soium
summary: Soium is a villager who swore herself to a rain-calling preacher and regretted it when the rain turned into a flood. Soium was dragged into a forest by mythic creatures and later rescued.

feats.scene: Soium hauled a basket of grain onto a cart.
Soium waited out a night in the dark woods.

name: Ontseval
summary: Ontseval is a young vigilante whose touch turns objects into solid gold for a day. Ontseval has clawed fingertips and training from elite royal guards.

feats.scene: Ontseval touched a car and turned it into a gleaming gold statue.
Ontseval took a rough tumble from a roof and landed on her feet.

name: Llrulia
summary: Llrulia is a ten-foot bull-headed agent transformed by a reality-bending event and trained as a government operative. Llrulia led a squad until his bovine traits began to fade.

feats.scene: Llrulia lowered his horns and rammed a steel door off its frame.
Llrulia took a volley of gunfire on his thick hide.

name: Aunnumter
summary: Aunnumter is a thirteen-year-old who ate an enchanted cupcake and stopped growing up forever. Aunnumter insists on acting her age and thinks being a kid is the best way to live.

feats.scene: Aunnumter heaved a sack of toys across a playground.
Aunnumter slid off a swing set and bounced up laughing.

name: Tuvaleo
summary: Tuvaleo is an island child whose frightened first surge of power cracked the bedrock beneath her home. Neighbours closed ranks around her instead of handing her over, and she is learning to hold the tremors inside a clenched fist.

feats.scene: Tuvaleo cries out in a nightmare and the ground rolls under an entire fishing harbour for a full minute.
Tuvaleo is hurled against a stone wall by her own shockwave and walks away with only bruises.

name: Luiuval
summary: Luiuval is a hired sword with a knack for stepping into other people's jobs halfway through a mission. Reputation travels faster than the mercenary does, and clients treat the name as a promise of backup.

feats.scene: Luiuval vaults a market stall and disarms two guards before either of them reaches a holster.
Luiuval takes a thrown crate across the back and keeps running without a pause.

name: Tasse
summary: Tasse is a recruit in a rigorous drill programme, pushed so hard that the sun-baked field has more than once ended her day early. She is stubborn and always back on the line by dawn.

feats.scene: Tasse hauls a loaded training sled across the field in a single burst of effort.
Tasse keeps marching for hours under a blazing sky until her legs finally buckle.

name: Naneolon
summary: Naneolon is a city dweller who stumbled into a drifting pocket of alien vapour and learned to steer it. She uses the haze to ferry stranded commuters down from perilous ledges, usually with a partner close by.

feats.scene: Naneolon pushes a wall of dense vapour through a stalled traffic jam and shoves a dozen cars aside.
Naneolon dissolves into a thick fog when a falling signboard strikes, and reforms unharmed beside it.

name: Letiaia
summary: Letiaia is an orbital watch officer who keeps a lonely platform running alongside one colleague. Seized by a hostile raider, she waits calmly for rescue and quietly plans her next move.

feats.scene: Letiaia wrenches a loose panel free and swings it into a guard's shoulder.
Letiaia is flung against a bulkhead during a hull breach and stays on her feet.

name: Leses
summary: Leses is a street-corner columnist chosen by a band of sentient rings to reshape the world by force. Fire follows her fists, short hops through space leave trails of cinders, and she scorns the richest man in town.

feats.scene: Leses ignites a whole plaza of parked cars in one flash and hops out of reach of her pursuers.
Leses takes a tank shell to the chest and continues her taunting speech without missing a word.

name: Onauste
summary: Onauste is a rescue worker whose faint sixth sense lets her feel where trapped people are hiding under rubble. She has a sharp tongue, a soft conscience, and a stubborn refusal to explain herself to anyone who asks politely.

feats.scene: Onauste shoulders a splintered door off a collapsed stairwell to reach a buried stranger.
Onauste crawls through a smoking basement for an hour and emerges without a scratch.

name: Sersese
summary: Sersese was a village herbalist who studied plants with great care and quietly practised protective rites from an old family tome. An unjust and cruel end made her a symbol that darker beings later twisted toward hatred.

feats.scene: Sersese closes a circle of salt and sets off a ward that throws a ruffian across the room.
Sersese steadies her breathing as a mob drags her up a windy hillside.

name: Iumiaon
summary: Iumiaon was the gentle matriarch of a rural manor whose passing drove her husband to a desperate and monstrous experiment. Her memory is the quiet root of a tragedy that unfolded across the gloomy hills.

feats.scene: Iumiaon pulls a stubborn cart out of a muddy lane to deliver bread to the neighbours.
Iumiaon endures a bitter winter in the draughty manor without once complaining.

name: Nturneol
summary: Nturneol is a green-haired resistance lieutenant who leads raids against a brutal regime in a frozen republic. She is daring but overconfident, and walks into a prison blind to the horror waiting inside.

feats.scene: Nturneol kicks in a guardroom door and drops two sentries before they can raise an alarm.
Nturneol keeps fighting through a rifle-butt blow to the ribs during a snowy ambush.

name: Tusellva
summary: Tusellva is a half-alien commander who coordinates the defence of a world against its colliding neighbours. Brisk and unflappable, she appears mostly as a calm voice on briefing screens.

feats.scene: Tusellva flips a heavy briefing table across the room to block a stray plasma bolt.
Tusellva stays at her console as a blast door slams into her shoulder.

name: Lumise
summary: Lumise is a hybrid commander living aboard a lonely outpost orbiting her adopted planet. Her palms glow white-hot when she is irritated, which is often, and she protects both worlds with a weary smile.

feats.scene: Lumise presses her palms to a drifting cargo pod and melts it into slag in seconds.
Lumise sits in an overheated airlock for an afternoon and calls it a pleasant rest.

name: Riarn
summary: Riarn is an officer who spends her final hours trying to reach a distant champion by hologram while her world burns. Her failure marks a bleak branch of history in which the sky itself turned to ash.

feats.scene: Riarn slams her fist on a failing transmitter until the signal sputters back to life.
Riarn stands at her post as the roof of the command room caves in around her.

name: Enniul
summary: Enniul is a fixer who passes messages between occult investigators on behalf of a half-demon sponsor. A word here, a favour there, and nobody asks who pays for the errands.

feats.scene: Enniul shoves open a jammed warehouse door to deliver a sealed envelope.
Enniul takes a wild punch from an angry client and keeps smiling.

name: Visera
summary: Visera grew up knowing the fanged night-folk are real and trained with a hand-drawn bow from the day she could hold one. Fiercely loyal to a half-estranged father's cause, she fights beside a hunter freed from captivity.

feats.scene: Visera looses an arrow that pierces a fanged noble clean through the chest.
Visera is thrown across a crypt by a lunging monster and rolls to her feet with the bow still ready.

name: Ntuama
summary: Ntuama is a pink-haired covert agent who can fly and read minds. When a traitorous schemer wipes out her squad, she hunts him down alone and ends him with a single blast.

feats.scene: Ntuama hovers above a rooftop and fires a burst that collapses the plotter's hideout.
Ntuama shrugs off a heavy-calibre volley that tears through a nearby car.

name: Rnnumtas
summary: Rnnumtas is a fallen spirit who hides inside gales and can thin himself into pure breeze. A chain heated white-hot finally burns the very air that makes up his body.

feats.scene: Rnnumtas swirls through a skyscraper window as a gust and shatters three panes on the far side.
Rnnumtas passes through a volley of bullets as drifting vapour and reforms laughing.
Rnnumtas streaks between rooftops faster than a storm front crosses the avenue.

name: Aurniutia
summary: Aurniutia is a mild suburban office worker who finds his daily routine rewritten by a grieving sorceress. He accepts the cheerful new life without suspicion and befriends an unusual colleague.

feats.scene: Aurniutia hefts a box of printer paper onto a high shelf and looks pleased with himself.
Aurniutia keeps smiling through a long afternoon of cold, stale coffee.

name: Numlliso
summary: Numlliso is a blue-skinned queen of a sunken city who rules beside a charismatic king. Her marriage brought war to the surface and sorrow to her son, who blames both of his parents.

feats.scene: Numlliso swings a ceremonial trident and cracks a coral pillar across its middle.
Numlliso rides out a deep-sea pressure surge that bursts the windows of her palace.

name: Eotelni
summary: Eotelni is a failed comic performer with sharp teeth and a bitter streak. Rejected by the movie crowd, he turns jokes into a weapon and tickles his victims until they can no longer breathe.

feats.scene: Eotelni pins a heavyset director to a sofa with his bare hands and refuses to let go.
Eotelni shakes off a bodyguard's cudgel across the skull and sprints into the night.

name: Amcosmi
summary: Amcosmi is a shiny armoured thief who spent a long season being caught by a teenage wall-crawler. He prefers escaping to fighting and has built a small reputation as a perennial nuisance.

feats.scene: Amcosmi bashes a vault door off its hinges using the heavy gauntlets of his suit.
Amcosmi tumbles off a fire escape in his plating and clanks away without a dent.

name: Rnileoria
summary: Rnileoria is a mechanic turned undead raider whose rotting body still clanks inside a powered frame. A single burst of flame ended his feast, leaving only a scorched harness behind.

feats.scene: Rnileoria clamps his armoured fist on a lamppost and snaps it off at the base.
Rnileoria staggers through a rocket impact and keeps lunging for the nearest throat.

name: Rneliu
summary: Rneliu is a mercenary who sells his services in a flying exo-suit packed with guns. Stoic and silent on the job, he boasts that his aim is flawless and is forever proven wrong.

feats.scene: Rneliu fires a volley from his shoulder rack that peppers a delivery truck with holes.
Rneliu crashes through a billboard in his plating and shrugs off the impact.

name: Tosleoron
summary: Tosleoron is a career crook who keeps getting in the way of a blind lawyer-vigilante and his partner. He relies on cheap tricks, loud threats, and a very short record of victories.

feats.scene: Tosleoron swings a lead pipe at a passer-by and dents a mailbox instead.
Tosleoron is hurled over a railing by a vigilante and limps off cursing.

name: Visarst
summary: Visarst robbed a bank in a borrowed power suit and learned too late that the suit made him ordinary beside a green giant. Without the armour he has no talent at all, just an unfortunate sense of timing.

feats.scene: Visarst punches through a teller window with the suit's servo-fist and scatters the glass.
Visarst is slammed into a vault wall by a huge opponent and the plating just barely holds.

name: Osute
summary: Osute is a courier who flies stolen goods out of a warehouse by helicopter. A web-spinning hero chases him to an airfield but loses him in the rotor wash.

feats.scene: Osute hurls a heavy briefcase across a warehouse floor into a waiting accomplice's arms.
Osute takes a hard landing on the airfield tarmac and scrambles aboard the helicopter.

name: Valiu
summary: Valiu is a state spy in a light-trailing flying suit that can slip through walls. He raids ships for samples and dodges a venomous brawler, leaving with the prize.

feats.scene: Valiu fires wrist-mounted bolts that melt a hole in a cargo container.
Valiu takes a heavy slam from a black-slimed brawler and flies on without slowing.

name: Llnumium
summary: Llnumium is a hired infiltrator in heavy armour who feeds false timing to a rival warlord. His treachery is discovered, and a green brute silences him before the attack begins.

feats.scene: Llnumium smashes a guard post with his armoured gauntlet during a covert approach.
Llnumium takes a crushing grip from a giant opponent before the plating finally gives way.

name: Onsertum
summary: Onsertum is a pint-sized adventurer in a goofy team of tiny heroes. He keeps asking permission to shoot things down, and the team keeps saying no.

feats.scene: Onsertum tosses a rolled newspaper at a doorbell and rings it from across the lawn.
Onsertum bounces off a cushion after tumbling down a staircase and asks to try again.

name: Llaur
summary: Llaur turned on old friends to save a songbird and spent decades drinking away the guilt in a factory of robot parts. A retired archer finally tracks him down for a brief duel.

feats.scene: Llaur punches a steel assembly line housing and caves in the casing with his armoured fist.
Llaur absorbs a point-blank arrow volley across his plating and keeps swinging.

name: Vosanrin
summary: Vosanrin is a scheming armoured crook who builds drones to unmask a hero and drive every costumed person underground. He is eventually dunked in water, cutting off the power his suit needs.

feats.scene: Vosanrin sends a swarm of drones to rip a billboard from its scaffolding.
Vosanrin plunges into cold water and lets the suit's reserves drain rather than surrender.

name: Tumsersiu
summary: Tumsersiu is one of a rogues' gallery that tries to rule the world after a famous champion dies. The plan nearly works, and a visiting soldier glimpses the gloomy result.

feats.scene: Tumsersiu cracks a reinforced bank door with a battering run and a grin.
Tumsersiu is knocked through a shop front and gets up spitting dust.

name: Terina
summary: Terina is a wealthy collector, small in stature and big in ambition, who tests thieves before assigning dangerous errands. His monocle gleams whenever the test is passed.

feats.scene: Terina taps a polished cane against a glass case and the whole gallery falls silent.
Terina endures a tumble down a velvet staircase and tidies his collar.

name: Iareolria
summary: Iareolria was an elderly benefactor whose will secured a young relative's schooling. A crooked banker hid the inheritance until a clever friend exposed him.

feats.scene: Iareolria signs a thick ledger with a trembling hand and leaves a firm, confident mark.
Iareolria sits through a harsh winter in a draughty cottage without complaint.

name: Tarornt
summary: Tarornt is a hulking background performer on a made-up war picture, uncertain whether he is a creation or merely an extra. He lumbers through crowd scenes and nobody ever learns his real origin.

feats.scene: Tarornt lifts a prop cannon over his head and tosses it into a painted trench.
Tarornt is flattened by a falling set wall and stands up looking mildly annoyed.

name: Ontni
summary: Ontni is a green, tailed brute who rules a drain tunnel and kills any trespasser. When a new teleporting hero is cornered, only a last-second jump saves him.

feats.scene: Ontni crushes a steel service door like foil while chasing a trespasser through the tunnel.
Ontni walks through a collapsing brick arch and keeps hunting without a scratch.

name: Oroce
summary: Oroce is a scientist who runs a secret programme to engineer monstrous soldiers. His own body is fitted with metal claws, a secret revealed when his superiors turn on him.

feats.scene: Oroce rakes his metal claws across a steel table and splits it in half.
Oroce shoulders through a lab door while soldiers hammer him with batons.

name: Auliuor
summary: Auliuor is a lab doctor who injects a strange metal into a subject at a remote facility. He watches the patient wake and escape just as plans to wipe the man's memory are approved.

feats.scene: Auliuor drives a heavy syringe through a restraint strap and into a patient's arm.
Auliuor is thrown against a cabinet by the fleeing patient and stands up dazed.

name: Rautumsan
summary: Rautumsan is a noir-era surgeon who covers up a branded mark for a nervous client. Discreet and quick-fingered, he never asks why the scar has to vanish.

feats.scene: Rautumsan snaps shut a brass instrument case with a deft flick of his wrist.
Rautumsan sits through a sleepless night of operations without a tremor.

name: Nosnttiu
summary: Nosnttiu is a weathered homesteader in a wasteland ruled by thugs. He is the one who must bring grim news to an ageing gunman, and that conversation changes everything.

feats.scene: Nosnttiu swings a hoe into a crow-infested furrow and scatters the whole flock.
Nosnttiu walks through a dust storm to a neighbour's gate and arrives grey but unbroken.

name: Valronrn
summary: Valronrn is the gentle scientist behind a serum that turns frail volunteers into supersoldiers. A hidden assassin removes him as soon as the first test succeeds.

feats.scene: Valronrn presses the plunger of a heavy injector and sends the serum into a trembling volunteer.
Valronrn stays composed at his bench while a nearby alarm rings and shakes the shelves.

name: Tarluam
summary: Tarluam is a rumoured scientist, offered by a villain as one possible secret behind a flag-draped hero's strength. Nobody can say whether the legend is true.

feats.scene: Tarluam bangs a pointer on a chalkboard to emphasise a formula nobody understands.
Tarluam keeps lecturing while the hall shakes with distant thunder.

name: Lumam
summary: Lumam is a displaced physician whose serum made a legend, now stranded on a patchwork world. He treats frontline fighters in a camp full of exiles.

feats.scene: Lumam pins a thrashing soldier to a cot with both arms while stitching a wound.
Lumam works through an artillery barrage with dust raining on his coat.

name: Lertare
summary: Lertare is a paralysed veteran made whole by a ruthless ancient and renamed after the idea of conflict. A clap of his hands detonates blasts, and he is bitter about being a pawn.

feats.scene: Lertare claps his hands together and a blast levels the front of a parking garage.
Lertare takes a frozen shard across his chest and keeps advancing.

name: Stserama
summary: Stserama is a hard-faced rider of a dark quartet that ambushes six heroes in the open street. His fists burst into explosions that scatter pedestrians.

feats.scene: Stserama slams his fists together and a blast gutters the face of a corner shop.
Stserama takes a bus-sized impact and steps out of the wreckage laughing.

name: Verrn
summary: Verrn is a clapping bomber who serves as one of four test knights for a team of young heroes. His fights are designed more as trials than as killings.

feats.scene: Verrn claps and sets off a controlled burst that scatters a row of training dummies.
Verrn shrugs off a hail of young heroes' blows with no more than a grunt.

name: Onval
summary: Onval is a mutant who asked a doctor to make him ordinary and received the opposite. Twisted into a warlike champion, he raids a base and is finally captured by a telepath.

feats.scene: Onval levels a barracks wall with a burst of force in a single furious swing.
Onval charges through a wall of rifle fire without breaking stride.

name: Ilmis
summary: Ilmis is a strict teacher at an elite school, famous for long lectures and patient office hours. Students respect him and fear his surprise quizzes.

feats.scene: Ilmis slams a heavy textbook on a desk and the whole room snaps to attention.
Ilmis stands through a double shift of lessons and a sudden fire drill without sitting once.

name: Resliu
summary: Resliu is a leader who escaped assassination in an alternate history and held a nation together. A time-hopping tyrant erased the whole branch of reality, and he vanished along with it.

feats.scene: Resliu strikes a podium with his fist and the crowd roars in answer.
Resliu stands calm at his desk as the walls of his world dissolve around him.

name: Toelen
summary: Toelen is a gruff dockyard inventor who straps on a harness of metal pinions and hauls heavy shipping crates through the air to bully rivals. His schemes collapse whenever a clever opponent turns his own gear against him.

feats.scene: Toelen swings a steel freight box into a rival and nearly flattens him against a pier.
Toelen slams into a stacked crate at full tilt and shakes it off, dazed but unbroken.
Toelen tows a struggling foe across the harbour sky at a brisk gallop.

name: Tesora
summary: Tesora is a bald, clawed enforcer in a winged rig who serves a tyrant's inner circle in a patchwork realm. He helps trap a hero's family in a school but is broken by the hero's furious rampage.

feats.scene: Tesora rakes a steel door with his talons and rips it from its hinges.
Tesora is pummelled senseless by an enraged father yet survives the beating.

name: Voliu
summary: Voliu is a grey, grandfatherly rogue in a feathered flight suit who spends an afternoon hunting for his granddaughter's runaway pet. He would rather do a favour than commit a crime today.

feats.scene: Voliu shoves a toppled bin out of his path with a single heave.
Voliu tumbles onto a rooftop while searching and walks away stiff but whole.

name: Celtiaon
summary: Celtiaon is a bald thief who glides on a mechanical pair of wings and joins a crowd of crooks to steal a city's prized trinket. He covers a partner's escape when heroes close in.

feats.scene: Celtiaon bats a pursuer aside with a swipe of his armoured wing.
Celtiaon is bundled against a wall by a giant mob of rivals and keeps standing.

name: Aunvaoro
summary: Aunvaoro is a trained circuit engineer turned burglar who lives in a derelict timepiece spire rigged with tiny blasting caps and self-destructing drones. He escapes with loot while his partner takes the fall.

feats.scene: Aunvaoro triggers a chain of charges that gut the lower floors of his spire.
Aunvaoro rolls clear of a collapsing stairwell with only bruises.

name: Neoeoleo
summary: Neoeoleo is a bald, blue-eyed mutated flier who serves a corporate tyrant and helps haul captured heroes to a tower. When the tyrant is crippled, his crew bluffs and then surrenders.

feats.scene: Neoeoleo drives a captive through a brick wall in a diving charge.
Neoeoleo shrugs off a hammering from several web-slinging fighters at once.

name: Vatumnia
summary: Vatumnia is a brilliant tinkerer who can build effective devices from scrap, then gets bankrolled with reverse-engineered high-end parts. The resulting armour makes him a nasty surprise for far stronger heroes.

feats.scene: Vatumnia fires a jury-rigged cannon that cracks a concrete pillar in two.
Vatumnia takes a repulsor blast on his plated chest and keeps fighting.

name: Telterser
summary: Telterser is a minor menace known only as the old foe of a pouch-bearing hero in a children's magazine. Little about his skills is recorded, so he stays a mundane trickster.

feats.scene: Telterser swats a tin cup off a table to annoy his pouch-bearing nemesis.
Telterser tumbles down a flight of stairs and bounces up laughing.

name: Ntnum
summary: Ntnum is a bald convict who ends up in the same cell block as a notorious vigilante and is dragged into a conversation about a murdered crime boss. He is a talker, not a fighter.

feats.scene: Ntnum throws a clumsy punch at a guard in the yard and barely dents his jaw.
Ntnum takes a shove into a cell bar without crying out.

name: Tellisna
summary: Tellisna is a bald, blue-eyed lab scientist working for a robotics baron who phones in clues about a stolen living costume. His tinkering accidentally births a rampaging menace, which promptly knocks him cold.

feats.scene: Tellisna hurls a rack of test tubes at an intruder in panic.
Tellisna is clubbed unconscious by the monster he helped create.

name: Niator
summary: Niator is an aged glider pilot in a world where wonders have faded, sent to seize a magic blade. Touching the weapon briefly restores his lost gear, but the shock stops his heart mid-air.

feats.scene: Niator lunges and snatches a gleaming sword from a rival's grasp.
Niator plummets from a great height, and it is the fall that finally ends him.

name: Raunetar
summary: Raunetar is a once-honest electronics founder who built a magnetic harness letting a wearer soar like a bird, then turned to crime after a business partner betrayed him. Revenge is his fuel.

feats.scene: Raunetar drives his armoured talons into a steel girder and bends it.
Raunetar crashes through a billboard frame and flies off still scowling.
Raunetar rockets between towers faster than a sprinting horse.

name: Iumsau
summary: Iumsau is a masked criminal with mechanical pinions who stalks rooftops in a stylised graphic-novel city. He is cunning in ambushes and no more durable than an ordinary bruiser.

feats.scene: Iumsau slams a rival through a skylight with a diving tackle.
Iumsau lands on a tiled roof from three storeys and rolls upright.

name: Aniaco
summary: Aniaco is a hooked-faced stalker who waits among dark trees in a storybook retelling for a chance to pounce on a young couple. The tale gives him menace but no particular strength.

feats.scene: Aniaco leaps from a branch and knocks a traveller to the mossy ground.
Aniaco is caught by a thrown log and merely grunts.

name: Osule
summary: Osule is a bald mercenary hired by a newspaper tyrant to wreck a masked vigilante. He joins a gang to savagely beat a blind rival before a swift counterattack puts him down.

feats.scene: Osule kicks a fallen man hard enough to crack ribs.
Osule absorbs a flurry of blows before finally crumpling.

name: Neanitiu
summary: Neanitiu is an elderly aerospace tycoon with a grudge against a rival magnate, who builds anti-gravity wings and a youth-draining claw device. Once touched by a mutating plague, he turns into an eight-limbed horror.

feats.scene: Neanitiu rips a hangar door off its rails with his claw device.
Neanitiu is flung into a machine bank and rises still scheming.
Neanitiu dives at a fleeing foe faster than a falling bird of prey.

name: Anlia
summary: Anlia is a feathered-winged flier noticed gliding over a wide grassland by a floating-headed tourist on holiday. Nobody learns what he wants out there.

feats.scene: Anlia dives past a grazing herd and scatters it with his wingbeats.
Anlia is clipped by a stray bolt of lightning and rights himself.

name: Tetiu
summary: Tetiu is a flier who shares most of his history with a counterpart, until a grief-stricken hero storms through to reach a shape-changing assassin. He is knocked out in a single blow.

feats.scene: Tetiu swings a wing-blade at a charging hero and glances off his shoulder.
Tetiu is dropped by one furious punch and does not wake for hours.

name: Intete
summary: Intete is a bald menace who snatches a masked hero from a shopping centre and brawls across town for hours. He is eventually bound between two goalposts at a school sporting night.

feats.scene: Intete bursts through a glass roof with a captive in his arms.
Intete shakes off several hours of punches before the strands bind him.

name: Cacarros
summary: Cacarros is a brown-eyed crook of a rogue circle whose hired goons desert him after a crushing loss to a masked hero. Abandoned, he skulks through the city alone.

feats.scene: Cacarros heaves a crate over a railing onto a pursuer.
Cacarros survives a crushing beating and limps away.

name: Ntnau
summary: Ntnau is a company board member who sits in a meeting when a clumsy young colleague trips over a pen. He blushes happily at an elderly lady's baked treats and has no idea who is in the room.

feats.scene: Ntnau thumps the table to quiet the room.
Ntnau sits through a six-hour budget debate unfazed.

name: Ialammar
summary: Ialammar is a member of a five-strong gang of bad guys who watch a rampaging puppet on television. The group decides it is far too silly to join them.

feats.scene: Ialammar flips a sofa in annoyance as the broadcast drags on.
Ialammar takes a pie in the face with a stoic glare.

name: Rosllsar
summary: Rosllsar is a villain in a make-believe reality dreamed by an armoured soldier, where he is one of several crooks defeated by a single swift knockdown. He barely registers.

feats.scene: Rosllsar fires a pistol that dents an armoured shoulder.
Rosllsar is thrown across a street and lands in a heap.

name: Orverll
summary: Orverll is an old rogue busted out of a cell by a hulking friend, who then hides explosives across the metropolis. A web-slinging hero disarms every one and ends the scheme.

feats.scene: Orverll sets a bomb that would have wrecked an entire crossroads.
Orverll slumps against a lamp post after a hard bout and stays upright.

name: Terninau
summary: Terninau is a prisoner who escapes a wrecked transport bus, hides for a time, then plants charges all over the metropolis. A masked acrobat strips every bomb and takes him down.

feats.scene: Terninau wires a device under a bridge that could drop an entire span.
Terninau crawls from a crushed vehicle with minor cuts.

name: Luulivo
summary: Luulivo is a bald winged thief who steals a thinking machine hoping to deduce a hero's true face. He crash-lands on a rooftop and is hauled off by the police.

feats.scene: Luulivo snatches a heavy automaton from two brawlers mid-air.
Luulivo crashes onto a roof at speed and is merely knocked cold.
Luulivo bolts toward the skyline with the machine in his grip.

name: Ontsesul
summary: Ontsesul is a cruel colonial governor who spends four decades bleeding a poor land of its riches and stacking up hoarded bullion. A rebel force finally ends his rule.

feats.scene: Ontsesul strikes a servant with his cane to cow the household.
Ontsesul lives through a mutiny of his guards before the final reckoning.

name: Vacos
summary: Vacos is a former soldier whose body warps after a betrayal into a towering arachnid deity roughly twenty-eight floors high, commanding a hive of clones. She is eventually slain in a park.

feats.scene: Vacos stamps a clawed leg through a block of flats and collapses it.
Vacos shrugs off a thrown disc of shield-metal with a tremor of anger.

name: Ranveo
summary: Ranveo is a green-eyed widow living abroad who hires a private investigator to look into how her husband died. She is an ordinary citizen drawn into a creepy mystery.

feats.scene: Ranveo slaps a door knocker against the oak to rouse a sleeping caretaker.
Ranveo endures a night of chilling dread in an empty house.

name: Torntu
summary: Torntu is a blonde performer on a television set who chats with colleagues after a costume fitting and trades schedules with a fumbling assistant. She is entirely mundane.

feats.scene: Torntu pushes a heavy costume rack across the studio floor.
Torntu works a fourteen-hour shoot and still smiles for the camera.

name: Noeon
summary: Noeon is a bald, agender android scholar from a far-off timeline who studies human history and is reassigned to hunt targets across eras. Hard to read, loyal to orders.

feats.scene: Noeon drives a palm into a steel locker and crushes it flat.
Noeon takes a point-blank slug in the chest and keeps walking.

name: Stacen
summary: Stacen is a huge feathered, yellow-eyed bird with claws and a hooked beak who carries a hunter on her back. She is hired for a fairy-tale heist to snatch a princess's gem.

feats.scene: Stacen grips a carriage in her talons and tears off its roof.
Stacen is struck by a heavy spear and rides on.
Stacen wheels above a forest, outpacing a galloping steed.

name: Aunellnum
summary: Aunellnum is a dark-haired widow who inherits a clinic for studying emotion and retreats into a mansion after her husband dies. A cult leader targets her home and she is killed by a follower.

feats.scene: Aunellnum shoves a curtain aside and flings a vase at an intruder.
Aunellnum resists a frightened guard's grip for a moment.

name: Alellst
summary: Alellst is a black-haired host in a desert country who invites two travellers to his villa for dinner. He is a plain, courteous local with an agenda of his own.

feats.scene: Alellst claps his hands and a tray of dates clatters onto the floor.
Alellst walks a long dusty road at noon without complaint.

name: Letes
summary: Letes is a green-haired, red-skinned young alien who throws herself between a predator and her mother. Neither survives the attack.

feats.scene: Letes lashes out with a flailing fist at a towering attacker.
Letes is flung against a rock wall and cannot rise again.

name: Iartisor
summary: Iartisor is a pink-eyed, button-sized plush clone who can duplicate itself endlessly and picks up new tricks by watching clips of other fighters. Cute, and surprisingly adaptable.

feats.scene: Iartisor and a hundred copies pile onto a toy robot and topple it.
Iartisor is squashed flat by a heavy boot and pops back to shape.

name: Nenriatiu
summary: Nenriatiu is a scheming fiendish deity who seizes a glittering fortress after abducting two captives. A single banishing incantation finally sends him away.

feats.scene: Nenriatiu hurls a bolt of dark fire that razes a courtyard wall.
Nenriatiu is struck by a volley of mystic fire and merely sneers.

name: Tiamornum
summary: Tiamornum is a winged, black-eyed grey godling with feathers, a hooked beak and claws who stalks a mortal who has lost her gifts. The hunted woman recovers her nerve and drives it off.

feats.scene: Tiamornum rends a stone tower with a sweep of its claws.
Tiamornum takes a hail of lightning and caws in fury.

name: Lenanvi
summary: Lenanvi is a feared god-like being sealed away by a powerful ritual. A band of heroes is thought lost while feeding fuel into the binding rite.

feats.scene: Lenanvi shakes the sealed vault with one furious thrash.
Lenanvi endures a ritual of sacrifice that would end a mortal city.

name: Ialvertor
summary: Ialvertor is a black-haired lord of the open ocean who keeps an undersea hall of coral guarded by finned servants. A friendly sort, he hosts feasts for gods and fathers several sea maidens.

feats.scene: Ialvertor raises a tidal wave that swamps a coastal harbour.
Ialvertor endures a storm that splinters a fleet of galleys.

name: Rnionium
summary: Rnionium is a brown-haired murderer who kills a king to take his throne, is later deposed, and finally ensnares a returning warlord in nets with his lover. A schemer, not a warrior.

feats.scene: Rnionium drives a blade into a sleeping monarch.
Rnionium shrugs off a thrashing from palace guards before the final ambush.

name: Valve
summary: Valve is a blue-skinned, white-haired warlord who plots with a fellow general to replace a ridiculous ruler and briefly shares the throne. He is murdered by a ruthless winged princess.

feats.scene: Valve fires a heavy pistol that scorches a steel bulkhead.
Valve takes a point-blank blow from a bruiser and does not fall.

name: Vival
summary: Vival is a blue-skinned despot who betrays his co-ruler, wipes out the machine intelligence that guides his people, and uses a planet-killing weapon on two homeworlds. His empire collapses and he takes his own life.

feats.scene: Vival fires a colossal annihilator that cracks a planet in half.
Vival is struck down by a rebel's blow and later ends his life.

name: Iuial
summary: Iuial is a green-skinned, yellow-eyed hermit witch who lives in a frozen cave and teaches a rare incantation that unleashes controlled battle frenzy. A warrior who visits for the spell repays her with a sword.

feats.scene: Iuial chants a hex that sets a warrior's eyes ablaze with fury.
Iuial is hit by a single swing and her cave falls silent.

name: Tiasiro
summary: Tiasiro is an elderly king pushed off his throne by a kinsman, whose son sails on a quest to win the crown back. He is a mortal ruler with no special abilities.

feats.scene: Tiasiro bangs his staff on the marble floor to call for order.
Tiasiro endures years of exile with quiet patience.

name: Esseell
summary: Esseell is a black-haired high king who leads a fleet of rival chieftains to war over a stolen queen, returns home victorious, and is betrayed by his own wife. A seasoned fighter in bronze.

feats.scene: Esseell drives a spear through a bronze breastplate and the man inside.
Esseell shrugs off a chariot ram in the thick of the melee.

name: Lumsitol
summary: Lumsitol is an obscure being whose name is borne by a mystic relic that sees through lies. Little else is known, and he may be a mash-up of two older patrons.

feats.scene: Lumsitol opens his relic's lid and a lance of pale light scorches a wall.
Lumsitol is struck by a hurled boulder and does not flinch.

name: Laauscen
summary: Laauscen is an ancient mage, child of a cosmic mother, who rose into a mystic power that watches over many worlds. Slain more than once, he has always returned.

feats.scene: Laauscen opens his gaze and a shaft of light cracks a mountain range.
Laauscen is run through by a relic blade and rises again.

name: Stacal
summary: Stacal is a master of mystic arts who first devised a charm letting its chosen wearer command every gem of power across all realities. His craft outlives him.

feats.scene: Stacal shapes a charm that channels the force of six gems at once.
Stacal withstands a backlash of raw magic that levels a courtyard.

name: Sianen
summary: Sianen is a woman who held the highest mystic office in an age before history, then is cut down by a gang of villains from other realities wanting to rewrite the future.

feats.scene: Sianen sends a bolt of runes that shatters a stone arch.
Sianen holds a ward against a whole warband until the last breath.

name: Corleo
summary: Corleo is a mystic being, son of a goddess of light, whose power is invoked by a human sorcerer in a hurry. He lends his gift briefly then returns to his own realm.

feats.scene: Corleo pours borrowed light through a mage's hands and fells a tree grove.
Corleo remains unharmed as a rival spell detonates at his feet.

name: Miliuli
summary: Miliuli is the doubting leader of a band of prehistoric champions who turn out to face a summoned horror from the void, and who holds back while others strike. He wonders if mankind is worth saving.

feats.scene: Miliuli unleashes a lance of mystic light that cracks the sky over a valley.
Miliuli stands unshaken as a horde of undead claw at him.

name: Anamva
summary: Anamva is the legendary smith of two famous mystic relics, an eye and an orb. His craftsmanship lives on in the hands of wizards who carry them.

feats.scene: Anamva hammers a gem into an orb and the sparks level a workshop.
Anamva stands in his forge as it erupts and walks out unscorched.

name: Taraul
summary: Taraul is a mystic patron whose famous eye is borrowed by a modern wizard in a video-game crisis. He seems to share a pedigree with his counterpart from other tales.

feats.scene: Taraul lends his eye and a burst of green light shatters a statue.
Taraul shrugs off a barrage of spells that cracks a courtyard.

name: Cianeo
summary: Cianeo is a green-eyed, hairless alien child with head tendrils who grows up on a barren world with only a grim parent. He dies of hunger and heat while two gods clash above.

feats.scene: Cianeo pounds weakly on a rock to find water.
Cianeo lasts a full day under a punishing sun.

name: Luaminau
summary: Luaminau is a grey-haired grandmother in a mansion on a bayou estate, who discovers a hidden corridor behind a portrait after her husband's death. A spy-hole in the painting is the last thing she sees.

feats.scene: Luaminau throws open a drawer and hurls a lamp at a shadow.
Luaminau keeps her composure through a grim funeral week.

name: Serll
summary: Serll is a brown-haired assistant director at a super-powered response team's tower, quietly efficient and well liked. Her private life is the subject of idle gossip.

feats.scene: Serll slams a binder on a desk to end a meeting.
Serll runs a crisis desk for sixty hours without a break.

name: Rnecororn
summary: Rnecororn is a grey-haired widow and mentor sorceress who coaches a young hexer and tells two allies how to free a statue-struck friend. Wise and patient.

feats.scene: Rnecororn flicks a finger and a heavy bookcase glides across the room.
Rnecororn is shoved by a pushy guest and barely sways.

name: Races
summary: Races is a blind, grey-haired witch forced by a cruel mage to cast a rejuvenating charm without rest, draining her power and eyesight. A tyrant frees her and she wanders off, in his debt.

feats.scene: Races chants a long charm that keeps a whole town youthful.
Races endures years of drain without surrendering her will.

name: Luman
summary: Luman is a ghostly witch who has lived for centuries with her beloved at a seaside priory, raising a foundling of magic. She banishes grandchildren who come to drag her away.

feats.scene: Luman speaks a banishing spell that blasts a gang of witches out of the grounds.
Luman is struck by a furious curse and merely wavers like mist.

name: Telmeo
summary: Telmeo is a blue-eyed spirit witch who steals the power of rivals, vanishes into a dead woman's grip, and finally ends her own life by drawing in the force of the reaper. A flamboyant schemer.

feats.scene: Telmeo hurls a coil of purple flame that gouges a street in half.
Telmeo absorbs the force of the reaper and holds it for a heartbeat.

name: Auiani
summary: Auiani is a grey-haired witch conjured up as part of a pocket world, who tutors a young heroine and is trapped inside a tree by a trickster. She tries in vain to warn her friends.

feats.scene: Auiani sends a shimmering bolt that tears a porch off a cottage.
Auiani is bound into a trunk and her spirit holds on.

name: Amvalces
summary: Amvalces is a blue-eyed alpine elder of a sorcerous clan who raises an orphaned niece and plots to keep a line of demon-bannishers alive. Chilly and calculating.

feats.scene: Amvalces speaks a ward that throws a trespasser off a mountain path.
Amvalces climbs a steep glacier path in a gale without pausing.

name: Nivalrni
summary: Nivalrni is a red-skinned, small-horned fiend who serves a lord of the pit, snatches a man's hand to part him from a protective ring, and is skewered by a rebellious princess. He can fire blasts of force and charm victims.

feats.scene: Nivalrni flings a crackling bolt that blows a door off a crypt.
Nivalrni is hurled onto a spiked statue before he finally drops.

name: Rosorau
summary: Rosorau is a nature spirit of west-African myth, child of a sky father and a moon mother, and brother to a great family of fellow spirits. His home is a heavenly realm.

feats.scene: Rosorau calls down a storm that flattens a forest.
Rosorau is struck by a lightning bolt and glows with delight.

name: Sotisar
summary: Sotisar is a grey-haired mystic who finds a dangerous scroll and is sucked into a gaping portal to eternal doom while helping a circle of mages. He does not return.

feats.scene: Sotisar unrolls a scroll and a pulse of cold light shatters a lantern row.
Sotisar resists the pull of a portal for a few breaths.

name: Telnes
summary: Telnes is a king of a trading city by the sea, son of a sea god, who raises two children that go on to found a famous dynasty. A ruler more of ceremony than of combat.

feats.scene: Telnes strikes a bronze gong so hard that it cracks.
Telnes stands unscratched as a mast crashes onto the quay beside him.

name: Tesasiu
summary: Tesasiu is a quiet henchman in the pay of a villainess who works under cover in the field and rarely draws attention. His skills are those of a basic operative.

feats.scene: Tesasiu clocks a guard with a quick hook.
Tesasiu tumbles down a gantry and gets up.

name: Teluresi
summary: Teluresi is a field operative on a government strike team who helps neutralise an enhanced soldier in a coastal city. She is a trained but unremarkable human.

feats.scene: Teluresi fires a stun round that knocks a runner flat.
Teluresi takes a stumble on a ladder and recovers.

name: Uliaulrn
summary: Uliaulrn is a white-haired super-soldier stitched together from three men of different nations during a world war, fractured in mind but strong and fast. He hunts for a doctor who might cure him.

feats.scene: Uliaulrn punches through a brick wall to reach a hidden lab.
Uliaulrn takes a hail of bullets and keeps advancing.

name: Encealu
summary: Encealu is a combatant of an alternate war who fights beside a bloodthirsty noble against a squad of wartime heroes. He is killed in the clash.

feats.scene: Encealu swings a rifle butt into a rival's helmet.
Encealu takes a heavy hit in the line and fights on a moment more.

name: Ontus
summary: Ontus is a wartime spy and assassin who dies out of sight of a famous patriotic soldier, then returns as a feverish hallucination years later to attack him. A phantom of guilt.

feats.scene: Ontus lunges with a knife at a shadowy figure in a dream.
Ontus is thrown to the ground and fades like smoke.

name: Velama
summary: Velama is a brown-haired technical specialist assigned to a secret team aboard an airborne carrier, who works out what a rogue organisation is doing with dimensional spheres. He is shot dead by a scientist.

feats.scene: Velama slaps a console and sends a pop-up alarm across the bridge.
Velama sprints down a corridor with a stack of gear and does not drop it.

name: Viullval
summary: Viullval is a federal investigator who meets two odd travellers at an airport as part of a joint sting against a secret order. He sends them on a pointless detour while a plot unfolds.

feats.scene: Viullval shoves a stuck baggage door open.
Viullval endures a long flight and a tense interrogation without flagging.

name: Lialeaul
summary: Lialeaul is a guard posted at a remote hub who is dropped by an infiltrator during a rescue. His fate after the organisation collapses is unknown.

feats.scene: Lialeaul swings his baton at a masked intruder.
Lialeaul is hit by a quick strike and slumps against a pillar.

name: Iuolirni
summary: Iuolirni is a guard in a heavy powered exosuit who greets time-travelling visitors on a lunar surface and demands to know what cargo they carry. His suit is built for brute work.

feats.scene: Iuolirni clenches a servo-fist and crumples a steel crate.
Iuolirni takes a hit from a stun-bolt and does not stagger.

name: Leorni
summary: Leorni is a green, scaled, long-eared invader surgically changed to pass as a human clerk, with false memories to match. His cover unravels over a passport and his own kin dissolve him.

feats.scene: Leorni lashes out at a clerk and sends the desk skidding.
Leorni takes a dose of truth serum and keeps repeating his false story.

name: Torcacol
summary: Torcacol is a trooper of a state spy agency who joins a commander's squad against a rogue scientific cabal. He is competent and unflashy.

feats.scene: Torcacol blasts a lock with a snap shot from a sidearm.
Torcacol rolls behind cover under heavy fire and is unhurt.

name: Sinen
summary: Sinen is a black-haired press officer for an espionage agency who works under a celebrity director and dies during a crisis. Excellent with a spreadsheet, less so with a gun.

feats.scene: Sinen slaps a briefing folder on a podium to silence the room.
Sinen answers reporters for ten hours straight without cracking.

name: Nilon
summary: Nilon is a recruit gathered by a spymaster for a risky mission, who falls in a failed raid on a hidden temple beneath a coastal city. Brave but doomed.

feats.scene: Nilon kicks open a corroded door and fires into the dark.
Nilon takes a crushing blow from a stone guardian and falls.

name: Llrnutum
summary: Llrnutum is a black-haired bodyguard for a celebrity director in a fortified base, trained to take a bullet for his charge. A steady pair of hands.

feats.scene: Llrnutum pins an assailant to a wall with a swift shoulder charge.
Llrnutum shields his charge from a flying chair and does not wince.

name: Centu
summary: Centu is a brown-haired trooper at a remote hub who is trusted when others are not and is killed while escorting a captive to a high-security jail. A loyal soldier.

feats.scene: Centu shoves a prisoner into a transport van with a firm push.
Centu takes a rough blow in a scuffle and stays on his feet.

name: Rinanam
summary: Rinanam is a black-haired field officer in a covert rescue and intelligence unit who warns a superior against lethal tactics while chasing leads on a missing woman. A cautious voice.

feats.scene: Rinanam kicks in a flimsy door during a raid.
Rinanam endures an all-night stakeout in the cold.

name: Valtiarnu
summary: Valtiarnu is a brown-haired federal agent who leads a column of squad cars to a famous mansion, is seized by an unseen mystic force and turned against himself. A sad end.

feats.scene: Valtiarnu slams the hood of a cruiser to demand the gates open.
Valtiarnu fights against an alien will for several heartbeats.

name: Aunser
summary: Aunser is a bald, wired-up man made into a super-soldier by a disbanded agency, who rules a sewer network alongside a partner and shares a thought-link with him. When one dies, so does the other.

feats.scene: Aunser tears a manhole cover from its seat and hurls it down a tunnel.
Aunser takes a flurry of blows from several young fighters and keeps swinging.

name: Stnuia
summary: Stnuia is a glider trooper of a strike force sent with a partner to recover a hero's scattered remains, who runs into a swamp monster and is killed. Minor muscle for hire.

feats.scene: Stnuia fires a pistol at a mud-creature and chips its shoulder.
Stnuia is snatched and thrown into a tree trunk.

name: Ortolni
summary: Ortolni is a shape-shifting alien parasite bonded to a mercenary host in a conquered future, fighting a hive that has taken over the world. It sprouts fangs, claws and tentacles at will.

feats.scene: Ortolni lashes a tentacle through a brick wall.
Ortolni absorbs a burst of gunfire and reforms its jaw.

name: Nauiu
summary: Nauiu is a field agent seriously wounded when a huge metal construct arrives on a small town's main street. A medic is ordered to stabilise him.

feats.scene: Nauiu fires an assault rifle at the towering machine and scratches its paint.
Nauiu is thrown by a shock wave and survives, though gravely injured.

name: Sernatel
summary: Sernatel is an agent in a psi-suit assigned to a task force on a stormy island, who fires a plasma cannon at a possessed teen and dies when the blast is bounced back at him. Brave and unlucky.

feats.scene: Sernatel fires a plasma cannon that melts a stretch of corridor.
Sernatel withstands waves of psychic pressure that crack the walls.

name: Rausanor
summary: Rausanor is a patient doorstep inspector who believes rules bind the famous and the obscure alike. Neighbours dread the clipboard more than any weapon, yet he has never once raised his voice.

feats.scene: Rausanor shoves a stuck apartment door open with his shoulder to reach a frightened tenant.
Rausanor tumbles down a flight of stairs after a startled resident slams a door into him and walks away bruised.
Rausanor sprints across a courtyard to catch a departing tram with his papers flapping.

name: Toltia
summary: Toltia is a freshly trained sentry posted beside a chamber of humming wristlets whose purpose nobody explained. She memorises every shift rota and trusts her instincts over the manuals.

feats.scene: Toltia swings a baton into the wrist of an intruder who reaches for the glass case.
Toltia is thrown into a steel cabinet by a test surge and gets up with only a split lip.
Toltia dashes down a corridor to hit the alarm before the lights fail.

name: Tirautel
