summary: Tirautel is a nervous marksman stationed on a floating deck, happier cleaning rifles than firing them. When a lone intruder breaks loose he fires once, misses, and decides the sky is the wrong place for him.

feats.scene: Tirautel fires a rifle round that whistles past an intruder's ear and punches through a bulkhead.
Tirautel drops from a low railing onto a cargo net and lies winded but unbroken.
Tirautel bolts along the deck toward the rail with a pack bouncing on his back.

name: Misileo
summary: Misileo is a mountain-pass lookout with sharp eyes and a talent for describing what he sees in dull, exact words. His reports have saved patrols from avalanches more often than from enemies.

feats.scene: Misileo hurls a signal flare across a ravine to mark a landing spot.
Misileo rides out a rockslide curled beneath an overhang, bruised and coughing dust.
Misileo skis the last stretch of slope to deliver his warning ahead of the weather.

name: Serlusvi
summary: Serlusvi tends a damp cellar archive where forgotten dossiers pile up beside leaking pipes. He knows every shelf by smell and treats visitors as a slight inconvenience.

feats.scene: Serlusvi heaves a full box of folders onto a trolley and sends it rattling down the aisle.
Serlusvi is buried under a toppled shelf and crawls out with a sprained wrist.
Serlusvi hurries up the stairs with a rescued ledger held over his head.

name: Tenesama
summary: Tenesama is a quiet tail-watcher who survives by never being noticed, until the one time somebody notices him. His notebooks of overheard talk are tidier than his flat.

feats.scene: Tenesama jabs an elbow into a pursuer's ribs while slipping through a crowded market.
Tenesama is slammed against a brick wall by a startled suspect and shakes it off.
Tenesama darts through an alley to keep a moving car in sight.

name: Iumtarva
summary: Iumtarva is a rifleman who follows orders until the moment they conflict with his conscience. He lowers his weapon, raises his hands, and takes whatever consequence follows.

feats.scene: Iumtarva fires a warning round into a stone floor and chips a crater the size of a plate.
Iumtarva is tackled to the ground by two guards and pinned without lasting harm.
Iumtarva runs from a collapsing doorway into the open air.

name: Niliaaul
summary: Niliaaul is a tunnel raider hired for muscle in a dig beneath an old harbour town. He trusts the crew's plan more than he should and pays for it underground.

feats.scene: Niliaaul swings a pickaxe into a sealed stone door and splits a seam.
Niliaaul is battered by falling masonry and keeps crawling toward the exit.
Niliaaul scrambles along a narrow gallery with a lantern swinging.

name: Amilumar
summary: Amilumar is a wing pilot who prefers to see the evidence with his own eyes before closing a case. His cautious questions irritate commanders and keep his squadron alive.

feats.scene: Amilumar lets off a burst from a cannon pod that shreds an abandoned shed.
Amilumar rides out a hard landing in a cracked cockpit with only a wrenched shoulder.
Amilumar banks his jet low over a burning field at cruising speed.

name: Cousser
summary: Cousser is a violet, shifting creature of living tissue that lends its strength to whichever soldier it clings to. It remembers every previous partner and fights with their stolen skills.

feats.scene: Cousser lashes a barbed tentacle through a parked truck and rips out its engine.
Cousser absorbs a collapsing wall of concrete and reforms its body afterward.
Cousser bounds across rooftops on stretched limbs after a fleeing target.

name: Sorni
summary: Sorni is a veteran door-guard who tries to hold a corridor against someone stronger and more determined. His stubbornness is admirable and his survival rate is poor.

feats.scene: Sorni drives a fist into a charging man's stomach and doubles him over.
Sorni is thrown across a hallway and slides into a wall without breaking anything.
Sorni lunges forward to bar the doorway before it is rushed.

name: Telanior
summary: Telanior is a stern squad member who volunteers first and complains afterward. He drills his team on an old deck until the routines are automatic.

feats.scene: Telanior empties a magazine into a steel plate and leaves it pitted.
Telanior takes a rifle butt to the helmet and keeps marching.
Telanior charges across a platform with his squad close behind.

name: Numsama
summary: Numsama is a background staffer in an underground lighthouse bunker who keeps the lights on and the rota tidy. Nobody remembers her name until the fuses blow.

feats.scene: Numsama throws a heavy breaker switch with both hands and the whole corridor hums.
Numsama is shaken by a rumbling blast down the hall and shields a colleague with her coat.
Numsama dashes between stairwells with a replacement bulb in her fist.

name: Liseoul
summary: Liseoul runs a quiet office that buys and borrows oddities for her employers, and she lectures visiting experts with unusual patience. Her relish for old maps is matched only by her mistrust of mystics.

feats.scene: Liseoul pushes a sliding vault drawer shut so hard it sparks against its rail.
Liseoul is thrown against a map table during an explosion and rises dusty and cross.
Liseoul hurries across a station concourse with a locked case under her arm.

name: Ontil
summary: Ontil is a dogged interrogator whose job is to unmask masked do-gooders. She leans on witnesses hard and relents only when a friend of the suspect walks in.

feats.scene: Ontil slams a flat palm on a metal desk and cracks a coffee cup.
Ontil is knocked backward through a flimsy partition and stands up scowling.
Ontil runs down a hospital hallway after a witness who bolted.

name: Rotelva
summary: Rotelva leads a cell of sneering saboteurs and is sentenced to a swinging blade trial for failing a single task. His rival's skill is the only thing sharper than the blade overhead.

feats.scene: Rotelva slashes a short sword through a rope bridge in a single stroke.
Rotelva is clipped by a swinging blade and keeps his footing for another few seconds.
Rotelva lunges across a pit to meet his opponent.

name: Lonam
summary: Lonam is a turncoat saboteur who slips a spool of film to his old enemies with a launch location on it. He dies on the road before anyone can thank him.

feats.scene: Lonam hurls a sealed film canister across a street into a waiting car window.
Lonam takes a rifle stock across the back and keeps running with the canister.
Lonam bolts through traffic to reach the meeting point.

name: Illonno
summary: Illonno is a government evaluator who studies hired killers for a living and writes cold, accurate verdicts on them. His disapproval reaches the right desks, and he likes it that way.

feats.scene: Illonno strikes a pressure point on a rude guard's neck and drops him on the spot.
Illonno is thrown over a table in a scuffle and straightens his coat afterward.
Illonno strides then sprints across a car park to reach a getaway car.

name: Rnoliu
summary: Rnoliu is a lab technician who has changed employers three times and believes in every one of them. His best moment is also his worst, when he fires a pistol at something much bigger than himself.

feats.scene: Rnoliu empties a pistol at a lumbering target and dents the wall behind it.
Rnoliu is swatted aside into a stack of crates and survives with cracked ribs.
Rnoliu runs to a glowing portal frame with a datapad clutched to his chest.

name: Tumoncor
summary: Tumoncor is a seasoned operative who gives sober advice that officials rarely heed. He prefers patience to confrontation and holds grudges against showy inventors.

feats.scene: Tumoncor shoves a heavy filing cabinet across a floor to block a doorway.
Tumoncor survives a collapsing balcony with a bruised back.
Tumoncor runs out of a shaking tower with a briefcase of notes.

name: Niais
summary: Niais is a duty officer who phones the proper experts the moment a yoga studio smells of something odd. His reputation for excess caution has an excellent record of being right.

feats.scene: Niais kicks a jammed studio door off its hinges.
Niais is pushed over a bench by a surge of light and gets up wheezing.
Niais sprints out to the street with the phone still pressed to his ear.

name: Corenan
summary: Corenan is a sturdy long-haul trucker who works as a secret courier and has a talent for bad luck. He once rode a lifted truck cab to a bone-rattling landing.

feats.scene: Corenan hauls a stubborn trailer latch open with a wrench and a roar.
Corenan crashes in a truck cab dropped from a great height and walks away with minor cuts.
Corenan pushes his truck to a highway sprint with the escort cars lagging behind.

name: Valtete
summary: Valtete is a recruiter with a steady voice and a cheerful way of describing awful assignments. She earns her pay by talking reluctant fighters into the field.

feats.scene: Valtete clubs a stubborn vending machine with her shoulder until it spits out a snack.
Valtete is blown over a railing by a passing shock wave and clambers up grinning.
Valtete races across a prairie road in a borrowed pickup.

name: Rnsole
summary: Rnsole is a bodyguard who follows one calm order and picks up a phone instead of a gun. Callers always find him composed.

feats.scene: Rnsole drives a fist through a rotten fence plank to clear a path.
Rnsole is thrown into a parked car and dents its door with his shoulder.
Rnsole runs down a fire stair to reach a working phone line.

name: Cessesval
summary: Cessesval is a protective escort who walks into a protest of one man and his friend. She never finishes the argument, and the argument finishes her.

feats.scene: Cessesval wrenches a fire door open and yanks a stranger out of a stairwell.
Cessesval is hurled against a stone pillar and clings on for another breath.
Cessesval lunges after a man heading for the door.

name: Ciltusni
summary: Ciltusni is a grey-haired mercenary who plays radio tech during staged raids, warning his crew when sirens approach. His calm voice masks a flat, ruthless streak.

feats.scene: Ciltusni cracks the butt of a pistol across a clerk's jaw during a staged holdup.
Ciltusni is slammed over a counter and rolls off with a split brow.
Ciltusni sprints to the van with his headset dangling.

name: Caltu
summary: Caltu is a space-station officer who is ordered to leave before the alien swarm can follow him out. He obeys at once and mourns the choice for years.

feats.scene: Caltu hauls a pressure door shut by hand and seals the swarm behind it.
Caltu is thrown against a bulkhead by a venting corridor and keeps his grip on a rail.
Caltu dashes to the escape pod bay through a flickering hall.

name: Rnitia
summary: Rnitia is a briefing courier who carries rolled reports between two famous heroes and an enemy's plans. His attention to detail is excellent and he never raises a fist.

feats.scene: Rnitia slams a heavy folder on a table so hard the two listeners jump.
Rnitia is knocked down by a rolling pressure wave and carries on speaking.
Rnitia jogs up the deck to hand off the final page.

name: Ausia
summary: Ausia is a wartime spy who can pass for anyone with enough greasepaint and nerve. Fifteen tongues and a drawer of masks serve a single, doomed mission.

feats.scene: Ausia slugs a sentry in a borrowed uniform and drags him behind a crate.
Ausia is thrown from a moving lorry and rolls to a stop with scraped palms.
Ausia bolts from a barracks in a stolen coat.

name: Liuteo
summary: Liuteo is a loyal officer who chooses the wrong side of a bitter internal dispute. A cloud of poison drifts in during the final week of the argument.

feats.scene: Liuteo fires a pistol at a dummy and splits its head clean off.
Liuteo is thrown across a briefing room by a shouting colleague and brushes himself down.
Liuteo runs through a busy lobby to join the faction's meeting.

name: Niace
summary: Niace is a veteran who fought beside a legendary soldier and finds himself on the opposing side at a forge. His excuse, that he follows orders, comes out flat and sad.

feats.scene: Niace levels a rifle and shatters a window frame with a single shot.
Niace is thrown across the forge floor and slides to a stop against an anvil.
Niace sprints toward the furnace with his weapon raised.

name: Uloli
summary: Uloli is a stealth bomber pilot with steady hands who delivers an unusual passenger over a foreign coastline. He drinks lukewarm tea afterward and says nothing.

feats.scene: Uloli drops a practice bomb that gouges a tidy crater in an empty salt flat.
Uloli rides out a heavy turbulence jolt strapped into his seat with a cracked visor.
Uloli pushes his bomber to cruising speed across open sea in the dark.

name: Oserni
summary: Oserni is a ship crewman who crash-lands on a hostile planet alongside a loyal flying cat and is calm enough to inventory the enemy's arsenal. He reports captured weapons as though they were groceries.

feats.scene: Oserni fires a captured rifle and blows a hole in a thin armoured door.
Oserni survives a hard splinter-craft landing and climbs out of the wreck unhurt.
Oserni runs through a ruined corridor with a heavy crate in his arms.

name: Teorcen
summary: Teorcen is a shadowing operative who trails henchmen through a foreign capital with frayed nerves. She is spotted at last, which is the whole point of the lesson.

feats.scene: Teorcen elbows a rear window out of a parked van to take a peek inside.
Teorcen is hurled onto a pavement by a surprised guard and winces back to her feet.
Teorcen runs down an alley to keep the henchmen in sight.

name: Nuneia
summary: Nuneia is a systems technician who spots something wrong with the network and reports it upward without fuss. His voice shakes, but his data is correct.

feats.scene: Nuneia yanks a jammed server rack drawer out of its rails in a hurry.
Nuneia is flung from his chair by a power surge and lies stunned on the carpet.
Nuneia jogs to the command console with a printout.

name: Lumneo
summary: Lumneo is a bald mercenary whose engineered body knits itself back together after being blown apart. He is cruel with a sample of blood and careless with his own flesh.

feats.scene: Lumneo drives his fist through a car door and drags a driver out by the collar.
Lumneo bursts apart in a violent blast and slowly reassembles on the dirt.
Lumneo runs down a rural road after a speeding sedan.

name: Liaron
summary: Liaron is a young strike team recruit who is picked by a veteran pilot because of an uncanny knack for staying calm. He serves a short season before an artificial mind turns on him.

feats.scene: Liaron fires a rifle round that rings off a steel locker.
Liaron is hurled across a training floor and lands in a roll.
Liaron sprints across a hangar floor with the team at his heels.

name: Tusiaoro
summary: Tusiaoro is a mind-reader pushed far past his limit by a commander who turns out to be a mechanical impostor. He gives everything and ends up empty.

feats.scene: Tusiaoro hurls a pulse of thought that cracks a glass partition between two rooms.
Tusiaoro endures a splitting headache from a mental overload and still stands.
Tusiaoro hurries along a corridor clutching his temples.

name: Rensersan
summary: Rensersan is a federal investigator who reports to a stern supervisor and takes notes in a cramped hand. A quiet career suits him fine.

feats.scene: Rensersan shoulders open a locked door during a raid and stumbles in.
Rensersan is thrown against a van and slides to the ground breathing hard.
Rensersan chases a suspect through a parking structure.

name: Tuiuseo
summary: Tuiuseo is an intelligence officer who works in tandem with a partner to corner a smuggler and use him as leverage. Her deals tend to unravel when decency shows up.

feats.scene: Tuiuseo wrenches a suspect's arm behind his back and clicks on the cuffs.
Tuiuseo is knocked into a street lamp and gets up with a grim smile.
Tuiuseo runs across a plaza to catch her fleeing partner.

name: Coneve
summary: Coneve is a dashing adventurer in crimson who crosses over from a neighbouring reality that is leaking into ours. He duels a rival in an elegant, theatrical manner.

feats.scene: Coneve fires a pistol and shatters a chandelier in one clean shot.
Coneve plunges from a balcony onto a stage and keeps his smile.
Coneve sprints along a gallery as the glass falls behind him.

name: Amall
summary: Amall is an aide who tells his boss that the situation room is ready. It is the only moment anyone ever remembers him.

feats.scene: Amall shoves a heavy conference door wide open to let the director through.
Amall is bowled over by a surging crowd and stands up straightening his tie.
Amall jogs ahead of the entourage to unlock the next hall.

name: Nenam
summary: Nenam is a nervous infiltrator who forges credentials and gasses guards without a word. As the mission unspools he grows afraid of his employers more than his target.

feats.scene: Nenam pops open a cell hatch with a crowbar and a grunt.
Nenam is slammed into a steel door by a startled prisoner and lingers in a daze.
Nenam jogs down a concrete tunnel, whispering excuses.

name: Noleoria
summary: Noleoria is a senior operative who riddles a corpse with bullets just to be sure, then is punished for a different failure. A glass of water ends his career in the most horrible way imaginable.

feats.scene: Noleoria empties an assault rifle into a motionless body in a dusty hangar.
Noleoria crashes through a plywood wall in pursuit and climbs out unscathed.
Noleoria drives a jeep flat out across a dry lake bed.

name: Cautor
summary: Cautor is a grey-haired cyborg who hunts a legendary soldier for an underground movement. His steel limbs are slow but unforgiving.

feats.scene: Cautor swings a steel forearm through a stack of cinder blocks and scatters them.
Cautor takes a speeding car head on and stays on his feet.
Cautor lumbers into a run along a pier after his quarry.

name: Oronti
summary: Oronti is a field officer who spends the aftermath of a monster fight handing a famous brawler a stack of forms. He is perfectly unflappable.

feats.scene: Oronti stamps a form so briskly that the desk shivers.
Oronti is flung back by a tremor and keeps hold of his clipboard.
Oronti hurries through the rubble to catch his signatory.

name: Rinriva
summary: Rinriva is a stockroom keeper entrusted with a dangerously heavy mass of weightless metal and told to hide the label. He does so without asking why.

feats.scene: Rinriva drags a sealed crate onto a lift with a chain and a heave.
Rinriva is pinned briefly against a shelf by a floating pallet and extricates himself.
Rinriva hurries to the vault corridor with the key card ready.

name: Cilrnor
summary: Cilrnor is a tall lawyer turned statesman, said to have been a champion wrestler in his youth. He raised a giant monument to himself that tourists still climb.

feats.scene: Cilrnor flips a burly challenger over his hip at a county fair and wins the purse.
Cilrnor shakes off a hard fall from a hay wagon and tips his hat to the crowd.

name: Lloorn
summary: Lloorn is a shambling undead statesman with an excellent aim and a dry sense of humour. A single shot to a mercenary's head is the story told over drinks.

feats.scene: Lloorn raises a flintlock and fires one shot that spins a jester's hat off his head.
Lloorn keeps walking after a cannonball takes a chunk out of his stovepipe hat.

name: Lisen
summary: Lisen is a bearded leader whose statue was swapped by a time-hopping villain. A giant ape ruins the plot and accidentally saves him from an assassin on a fateful night.

feats.scene: Lisen pounds a lectern with his fist and a candle topples over.
Lisen is knocked off his feet by a crashing ape and gets up brushing off his coat.

name: Ontia
summary: Ontia is a ghostly orator who attends a roast thrown for a loud-mouthed mercenary. Spirits keep better manners than the host, and he leaves the party without a word.

feats.scene: Ontia raps a spectral knuckle on a table and the glasses rattle once.
Ontia shrugs as a thrown bottle passes through his chest and shatters on the wall.

name: Iumiava
summary: Iumiava is a grey-haired deli keeper who lost his shop when a tower was flung into the sky. He shouted at the scientist responsible, who promised to pay for it.

feats.scene: Iumiava slaps a pastrami down on a counter hard enough to split the paper.
Iumiava keeps shouting as the floor tilts and shelves topple around him.

name: Vaell
summary: Vaell was a nineteenth-century local legend of a fishing hamlet, memorialised by a bronze figure leaning on a cane. An alien ruins the memorial, and an orange rock-man uses it as a projectile.

feats.scene: Vaell hauls a net full of herring onto the dock with a single heave.
Vaell, as a bronze likeness, is flung across the square and lands with only a dent.

name: Iumveo
summary: Iumveo is a writer who discovers an old diary at a bookstall and decides to turn it into a novel. His friends laughed with him and later wept over the book.

feats.scene: Iumveo bangs a quill on the desk and a dozen loose pages flutter to the floor.
Iumveo writes through a freezing night in a draughty study and finishes the chapter.

name: Leous
summary: Leous is an elderly scholar-hunter who nearly slew a famed vampire. His descendants inherit the family feud, and the family crest hangs in many a study.

feats.scene: Leous drives a sharpened stake through a coffin lid with one practised thrust.
Leous takes a clawing from a fanged foe and returns to his lecture hall that same evening.

name: Lloaun
summary: Lloaun is a student whose body became a glowing envelope controlling his own bones. When the power faded, nobody knew whether the boy survived the blast on the school bus.

feats.scene: Lloaun flares a halo of light around his ribs and knocks a locker door off its hinges.
Lloaun is jolted by a bus blast and lies motionless for a long while.

name: Rneoli
summary: Rneoli is a blind retiree who once misplaced a briefcase at a diner. A masked helper retrieves his keepsake, and neither of them mentions the missing portrait.

feats.scene: Rneoli taps his cane on the pavement and the sound echoes down the alley.
Rneoli sits through a long hospital night recovering from a sudden stroke.

name: Tutesval
summary: Tutesval is a grey-haired weapons maker and mentor to a half-vampire fighter. Grief drives him to hunt the undead every night from a cluttered workshop of silver and stakes.

feats.scene: Tutesval fires a silver-tipped bolt that pins a fanged prowler to a brick wall.
Tutesval limps through a night of pursuit with a bad leg and never slows his stride.

name: Rnull
summary: Rnull is a boy born on an irradiated island who swells into a clawed green giant when angry. Fury ended the life of his own parent, and the legend lingers among the jungle survivors.

feats.scene: Rnull rips a jungle ridge in half with a single swipe of his claws during a tantrum.
Rnull laughs as a rain of heavy shells bursts across his massive green back.

name: Amniu
summary: Amniu is a mutated slaver whose arms became long squid-like limbs that flay and crush. His bargain with alien masters cost him the loyalty of his crew.

feats.scene: Amniu whips a suckered limb across a cargo crate and cracks it like an egg.
Amniu keeps lashing out after a heavy rifle round tears through his shoulder.

name: Ialameest
summary: Ialameest is the shadow of creation, a many-armed green force that sees perfection in emptiness. Caged by rival powers across every reality, it breaks loose to unmake whole cosmoses.

feats.scene: Ialameest closes six great hands and a sweeping wave collapses a cosmos into silence.
Ialameest stands unmoved while a swarm of rival powers pounds it across a dozen realities.

name: Luscor
summary: Luscor is a living dwarf star with a single scarlet eye. Passengers who pass through his glow reappear wherever they imagine in the void.

feats.scene: Luscor flares his burning body and lights up half a nebula for an entire season.
Luscor drifts through a raging cosmic storm and loses nothing but a little glow.

name: Rniaus
summary: Rniaus is a digital copy of a teenager who hacked her way out of a game. She learns each level so thoroughly that she can bend it, and helps real players escape their prison.

feats.scene: Rniaus rewrites a platform in mid-leap and sends a rogue sprite tumbling into a pit.
Rniaus shrugs off a corrupt data blast that scrambles every pixel around her.

name: Amamarni
summary: Amamarni is a muscular extra on a cinematic battle epic filmed in a dream-studio dimension. Nobody knows if he is native or just an actor on a very long contract.

feats.scene: Amamarni hurls a rubber boulder through a painted fortress wall and the crew cheers.
Amamarni takes a prop cannon blast in a battle scene and gets up for another take.

name: Stama
summary: Stama is the leader of an underground network that smuggles refugees across borders. Charming, shifty and always moving, he vanishes before the authorities arrive.

feats.scene: Stama shoves a barrel across a cellar floor to hide a trapdoor.
Stama crouches in a freezing tunnel for a night and comes out ready to talk.

name: Tetel
summary: Tetel is a rebel chief who finds a gleaming sky-forged blade and declares himself a deity. The energy he absorbs eventually rots his body, and a shield-maiden brings him down.

feats.scene: Tetel drives the blade into a stone wall and a crack races up a whole palace tower.
Tetel absorbs a blast from a swung shield and then falls apart from within.

name: Netumus
summary: Netumus is an eighth-century scholar who tried to build a machine to preserve the world by gathering human wishes. The device failed, and it drained the volunteers who fed it.

feats.scene: Netumus throws a lever and a ring of brass gears bursts into sparks across a vaulted chamber.
Netumus stands at the core of the failing engine as light pours from his robes.

source_title: Abu Mūsā Jābir ibn Hayyān al-Azdi (Earth-616)

name: Orsos
summary: Orsos was a coastal sultan who played both sides in a deal with sea-raiders. His double dealing led to a knife in the dark.

feats.scene: Orsos hurls a purse of coins onto a counting table and the whole court falls quiet.
Orsos staggers up a mosque stair after a stab wound and still delivers his final speech.

name: Rniniu
summary: Rniniu is a genetically hardened gunman immune to poisons, plagues and radiation. A terror cell values him because nothing in the usual arsenal can stop him.

feats.scene: Rniniu empties a magazine into a convoy and wrecks the lead truck.
Rniniu stands calmly in the centre of a bomb crater and walks out of the fallout.

name: Tuleo
summary: Tuleo is a nameless victim of a worldwide plague in a parallel reality. Little survives of him except a line in a roll of the lost.

feats.scene: Tuleo pushes a stuck window open to let in the evening breeze.
Tuleo battles a high fever through a long and silent night.

name: Amcoror
summary: Amcoror is a void predator who devours matter and snuffs out whole realities while crossing between them. He loathes anything solid and hides in the nothing between worlds.

feats.scene: Amcoror opens his jaws and a whole sky of galaxies folds silently into his gullet.
Amcoror shrugs off a bomb dropped through a rift that rips a hole in his chest.

name: Corval
summary: Corval is a conjoined pair with blank faces, reshaped by a reality-twisting storm. Hunted by a secret agency, they flee with a band of kind guardians.

feats.scene: Corval clamp their joined arms around a gatepost and wrench it free of the ground.
Corval shrug off a truncheon strike and run on without breaking step.

name: Valeo
summary: Valeo is a smooth-faced guest at a dream wedding conjured by a sleeping woman. In waking life nobody remembers his name.

feats.scene: Valeo raises a glass of cordial and a toast rings through the dream hall.
Valeo sways through a long dance without a trace of fatigue.

name: Oliosuium
summary: Oliosuium is a trained hunting bird who serves a sorceress queen. It glides over her castle at dawn and brings back mice and rumours.

feats.scene: Oliosuium folds its wings and dives talons-first onto a fleeing rat.
Oliosuium tumbles in a gale, rights itself, and glides home on one worn wing.
Oliosuium stoops from the battlements faster than a galloping horse.

name: Elltia
summary: Elltia is a scaly four-fingered agent with two pistols who chases a mammal terrorist through the primeval ooze. His enemy's plan to push him down the ladder of life shuffles history itself.

feats.scene: Elltia fires both pistols at once and drops a pair of leaping thugs.
Elltia rolls through a hail of darts and keeps his pistols up.

name: Vanau
summary: Vanau is a bush pilot who flew medical runs and befriended a sea captain. Everyone says he could fly through a storm with his eyes shut.

feats.scene: Vanau wrenches a stuck throttle lever free with both hands.
Vanau walks away from a bumpy crash landing with a cracked pair of goggles.

name: Nanrecor
summary: Nanrecor is a high-school senior who hangs out at the soda counter with friends. Crushes, cars and test-day nerves fill his week.

feats.scene: Nanrecor drives a punch into a punching bag at the gym and wheezes proudly.
Nanrecor takes a football to the stomach and still cracks a joke.

name: Aunte
summary: Aunte is a grey-haired ex-con released after a stint for robbery. He teams with a jester to settle a score with a moonlit vigilante.

feats.scene: Aunte swings a crowbar at a padlock and splits the hasp clean through.
Aunte is thrown into a trash heap by a masked foe and crawls out swearing.

name: Cormece
summary: Cormece is a blue-skinned tinkerer from a sunken neighbourhood who swims fast and builds water-saving gadgets. On land he wears a water helmet, since he gets only minutes without it.

feats.scene: Cormece cranks a lever on a homemade pump and sends a jet that knocks a thief flat.
Cormece ignores deep-sea pressure that would crumple a steel diving bell.
Cormece darts through a kelp forest as quick as a motorboat.

name: Rnicauas
summary: Rnicauas is a bull-horned river god who can slip into the shape of a snake. Pressed into service as a bodyguard, he fights for a tyrant and dies in a street brawl.

feats.scene: Rnicauas gores a delivery van with his horns and flips it over a median.
Rnicauas stands in a flood-swollen current that rips a bridge apart and is merely soaked.

name: Rirni
summary: Rirni is a petty crook who dons a winged costume handed over by a crime lord. The costume does not make him brave, and he is jailed after his first heist fails.

feats.scene: Rirni swings a crowbar through a jeweller's window and grabs a tray of rings.
Rirni is flung over a counter by a determined woman and groans into the tiles.

name: Ontteau
summary: Ontteau is a golden warrior whose body was dipped in a legendary river, leaving him impervious save for one weak spot. He commands a loyal troop and meets a poisoned end before the city's high gates.

feats.scene: Ontteau hurls a spear that punches through a siege tower and splinters its frame.
Ontteau stands in a rain of boulders and arrows without so much as a bruise.

name: Levorco
summary: Levorco is a golden-haired soldier of an ancient siege who wins glory and doubts it. A secret friend disguised among the troops keeps him going.

feats.scene: Levorco drives a spear through a shield and the man behind it.
Levorco climbs a ladder under a hail of stones and refuses to retreat.

name: Meocalnan
summary: Meocalnan is a famous warrior rendered unkillable by a magic bath. He died anyway, remembered in verse by a detective riding a time machine.

feats.scene: Meocalnan sweeps a bronze sword through a wall of shields and scatters a dozen men.
Meocalnan walks through a volley of spears and arrows and shakes the dust from his hair.

name: Vauson
summary: Vauson is a young prince and sword fighter who joins a barbarian against a lion-masked tyrant. Surrender earns him no mercy.

feats.scene: Vauson cleaves a rider off his saddle with a single overhand stroke.
Vauson fights on after a mace blow dents his helm and rings his skull.

name: Cortan
summary: Cortan is a street thief who trains orphans to pick pockets. A weather-working girl learns her first lessons from him.

feats.scene: Cortan shoves a fruit cart into a pursuer's path and slips down an alley.
Cortan drops from a rooftop onto a canvas awning and rolls away unhurt.

name: Isinte
summary: Isinte is an armoured automaton that sprays acid to bring down tenements for a crime syndicate. A time-travelling soldier shuts it off.

feats.scene: Isinte sprays a gout of acid across a brick wall and the whole tenement slumps into rubble.
Isinte shrugs off a heavy cannon round that dents only its outer plating.

name: Niaoror
summary: Niaoror is a spy from a collapsed empire who impersonates his target's best friend. A single angry punch from the genuine armoured man ends the masquerade.

feats.scene: Niaoror slips a stolen helmet under his arm and shoves aside a startled guard.
Niaoror reels from a furious armoured punch and lies sprawled and astonished.

name: Isiumnum
summary: Isiumnum was a clan elder in the dawn of farming who chose to appease a meteor-fed hunger. The sacrifice cost him his son's trust and, finally, his own life.

feats.scene: Isiumnum shoves a young man toward a glowing crater with both hands.
Isiumnum survives a drought-stricken season on dust and a handful of dates.

name: Nistel
summary: Nistel is a young street thief and a fast talker. Her stories about growing up are told to a girl who will one day command storms.

feats.scene: Nistel snatches a wallet from a passing trader's belt and darts into the crowd.
Nistel sleeps through a cold night in a crate and wakes sneezing but cheerful.

name: Ellantos
summary: Ellantos is a bald, blue-eyed boy grown in a laboratory nursery. He escapes his captors and wakes a green giant who becomes his protector.

feats.scene: Ellantos tugs a heavy bunker door handle with both small hands until it clicks.
Ellantos crouches through an alarm-blasted corridor and comes out dazed but whole.
